updates.title: AppLovin guides Q2 2026 revenue $1.915-1.945B, +52-55% YoY
updates.summary: AppLovin (reports Aug 6) guided Q2 2026 revenue to $1.915-1.945B, implying 52-55% YoY growth, with adjusted EBITDA $1.615-1.645B at 84-85% margin. Q1 2026 came in at $1.84B (+59% YoY). Management is rolling out Axon (AXON 2 AI engine) to all advertisers, opening the platform beyond mobile gaming into ecom.
updates.action: AppLovin's ecom push via Axon 2 is the most interesting new ad-buying channel for DTC brands this year - the mobile gaming ML is now targeting shopping. For ecom clients hitting CPA ceilings on Meta/Google, worth a $10-25K pilot in Q3. Expect scarce inventory to price up fast as more brands find it.

updates.title: Trade Desk guides Q2 2026 $750M+, betting on open internet vs walled gardens
updates.summary: The Trade Desk (reports Aug 6) guided Q2 2026 revenue at least $750M and ~$260M adjusted EBITDA, targeting FY26 adj EBITDA margin of at least 40%. Q1 2026 came in at $689M (+12% YoY). Zacks consensus for Q2: $751.6M (+8.3% YoY). Gross margin at eight-quarter low, per analyst notes.
updates.action: TTD's growth deceleration (12% Q1, ~8% Q2 consensus) versus Amazon Ads (+26%) and Reddit (+64%) tells the story: open-internet programmatic is losing to walled gardens. For clients running open-web DSP, retention is fine, but net-new budget dollars are better placed in retail media or ChatGPT/AI ad channels this half. Watch TTD's Aug 6 report for CTV segment specifically.

updates.title: Roku Q2 2026: platform revenue guided ~20%, total net revenue $1.3B
updates.summary: Roku (reports Aug 6) guided Q2 2026: platform revenue +~20% YoY, devices -high-single-digits, total net revenue $1.3B (+~17% YoY). Total gross profit $580M. Adjusted EBITDA $170M. Full-year 2026 outlook: platform revenue ~$5.0B (+21%), devices ~$535M, total $5.5B. US programmatic CTV market projected at $38B in 2026 (up from $33.4B in 2025).
updates.action: Roku's ad growth is still real but Netflix is now the alternative that didn't exist a year ago - reallocate a portion of Roku spend to test Netflix biddable, especially for younger-skew audiences where Netflix has stronger monthly reach. Roku still wins for open programmatic buys where Netflix is more upfront-heavy.

updates.title: Spotify Q2 2026: ad-supported revenue -5% reported, +3% ex-FX
updates.summary: Spotify reported Q2 2026 pre-market Aug 4. Analyst consensus was $5.55B revenue (+16.7% YoY) and $3.27 EPS. Ad-supported free-tier revenue fell 5% as reported but rose 3% ex-FX, with underlying strength from music impressions and podcast sponsorships. Management guided that ad growth accelerates in H2 as newly scaled biddable channels offset legacy direct-sales choppiness.
updates.action: Spotify's ad tier is a slow-burn recovery story - don't overweight it in Q3 plans, but the biddable channel expansion is the item to watch. For podcast clients specifically, Spotify sponsorship pricing may soften into H2 as they push volume through the auction. Time renewals accordingly.

updates.title: Aug 17 Google Ads bidding change enforces CPA/ROAS targets on budget-limited campaigns
updates.summary: Starting August 17, 2026 Google is changing bidding behaviour for budget-limited campaigns using Target CPA or Target ROAS. Campaigns will bid toward the target you set rather than the more aggressive target Google's algorithm discovered was achievable. Example from Google's documentation: a $10 tCPA campaign currently hitting $5 will move closer to $10 unless the target is lowered. Scope: Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen and Travel across Google Ads, SA360 and DV360.
updates.action: This week, audit every account for budget-limited Search/PMax/Shopping/DG campaigns on tCPA or tROAS. Use the Bid Target Adjustment Tool now live in Google Ads (rolled out from Jul 6) to review historical performance and reset targets to match actual efficient CPA. Skipping this = CPL/CPA drift on Aug 17 and awkward client conversations in September.

updates.title: Snap Q2 2026: revenue +19% to $1.6B, other revenue +85% on Snapchat+
updates.summary: Snap reported Q2 2026 on Aug 3: total revenue $1.6B (+19% YoY). Advertising revenue grew 9% to $1.28B (CEO Evan Spiegel noted 'improving momentum'). Other revenue (Snapchat+, Memory Storage, Lens+) surged 85% to $316M. Gross margin +7pp to 58%. Adj EBITDA $250M. DAU 493M, MAU 971M. Q3 guidance: $1.70-1.74B. Shares +17% after-hours.
updates.action: Snap's ad business is finally re-accelerating - 9% ad growth beats a year of near-flat quarters. Worth a fresh look for DTC brands with a Gen Z audience. The subscription revenue story matters strategically: Snap is diversifying off ad-only, so ad prices may firm up as they de-emphasise pure volume. Test now while CPMs are still soft.

updates.title: Meta launches Holiday Insights Center - $1.4T retail forecast
updates.summary: Meta published its 2026 Holiday Insights Center on August 2. Key stats: US holiday retail projected at $1.4T, online growing 2.5x faster than in-store, 85% of Meta users bought in-store after seeing a product on social, 59% messaged businesses in-season, 49% of holiday shoppers plan to outspend 2025. Meta recommends launching by mid-October to give the algo learning runway before the 28-day BFCM-to-Christmas window.
updates.action: Lock Q4 planning calls by end of August. Move creative production for BFCM up two weeks - if algo needs mid-October start, briefs need to be signed off in September. Add the '85% in-store after social' stat to any brand-lift pitch for retail clients.

updates.title: EU AI Act: transparency and GPAI enforcement powers activate Aug 2
updates.summary: On Aug 2 2026 the European Commission's AI Office began enforcing the AI Act. Article 50 transparency rules now apply: chatbots must disclose they are AI, deepfakes must be labelled, and AI-generated/altered ad content must be identifiable. Enforcement powers over general-purpose AI providers activated. Fines reach EUR 15M or 3% of global annual turnover, whichever is greater.
updates.action: Any client running AI-generated creative, AI chatbots or AI-personalised messaging into the EU needs a labelling audit this week. Voiceover deepfakes, AI-generated stills and AI-video ads all fall under Article 50. Add a disclosure line to briefs. Non-compliance risk is now material - 3% of global turnover is a real number for enterprise clients.

updates.title: Brand mentions correlate 3x more strongly with AI visibility than backlinks
updates.summary: GEO research consolidated through July-August 2026 confirms brand mentions correlate 3x more strongly with AI-answer visibility than backlinks (0.664 vs 0.218 per an Ahrefs 75,000-brand study). 82% of AI citations come from earned media, not owned or paid (Muck Rack). 85% of brand mentions in AI answers originate from third-party pages, not the brand's own domain — brands are 6.5x more likely to be cited via third-party sources (AirOps). Overlap between top Google results and AI-cited sources fell from ~70% to under 20% between 2024 and 2026 (Brandlight).
updates.action: Reweight every SEO/GEO retainer: budget for digital PR and earned-media placements should now match or exceed the backlink-building line item. Track brand-mention share-of-voice across Reddit, YouTube, and industry publications monthly. For any client whose AI-answer visibility is flat despite good rankings, the fix is third-party citation, not on-page SEO.

updates.title: Meta Business Agent transitions from free test to token pricing
updates.summary: Meta Business Agent (the WhatsApp/Instagram/Messenger AI sales-and-service agent) exits its free test window on July 31, 2026 and starts billing August 1 at $2.00 per million tokens. Estimated cost: 4-5 cents per simple chat, up to ~$0.24 for a longer sales conversation. Over 1M businesses were on the free tier at launch.
updates.action: For any client running Business Agent on WhatsApp/Messenger, forecast a new line item in August billing. Set a conversation-volume alert and estimate monthly token cost before day 30 hits. Compare against human agent cost per resolution to decide keep/pause.

updates.title: Amazon Prime Video sports ad inventory sells out per Q2 earnings commentary
updates.summary: In post-earnings coverage published July 30 to August 1, 2026, Amazon and analysts confirmed Prime Video sports ad inventory (NBA, NFL Thursday Night Football, WNBA, Champions League) has sold out or is near capacity for the coming season. Ad revenue on Prime Video is now the fastest-growing component of Amazon Ads and a key reason for the 26% YoY growth in Q2. Q3/Q4 inventory expected to be tight; brands wanting sports CTV placement should be locking in commitments now.
updates.action: If a client has any CTV / sports sponsorship intent for Q4 2026 or Q1 2027, engage Amazon Ads reps this week. Waiting until quarter start means missing NFL and NBA inventory. Consider Freevee and Amazon-owned entertainment (Reacher, Fallout) as spillover if sports is booked out.

updates.title: Product Hunt July winners: AI marketing agents embed in Slack, not new apps
updates.summary: July 2026 Product Hunt marketing/AI leaderboard was dominated by agents that live inside existing surfaces rather than new apps. Scarlett (393 upvotes July 11) is an AI co-worker in Slack and iMessage that bridges CRM and marketing tasks. Viktor is another Slack-native agent that pulls context from existing tools. Pebbles AI is a B2B sales/marketing platform. AI Media Buyer by Creatify is an ad-management agent that gets smarter daily.
updates.action: For agency clients on Slack-first ops, test Scarlett or Viktor before recommending new-app marketing tools — user adoption is 3-5x higher when the AI lives in the existing chat surface. For paid social clients, benchmark AI Media Buyer by Creatify against your current AOR fee: if it hits 80% of your quality bar at 20% of the cost, it changes what services agencies can profitably offer.

updates.title: Anthropic + Cognizant expand partnership to push Claude into enterprise
updates.summary: On July 27, 2026 Cognizant and Anthropic announced an expanded partnership to deploy Claude across enterprise clients, focused on regulated verticals and complex agentic workflows. Combined with Snowflake's separate Anthropic partnership announcement targeting governed enterprise AI, this signals Claude is the model of choice for enterprise buyers who need audit trails, private-network tunnels, and MCP-based tool control that ChatGPT Enterprise still lags on.
updates.action: For enterprise-tier clients (regulated verticals, procurement-heavy buyers), lead the AI stack conversation with Claude Enterprise + MCP servers, not ChatGPT Enterprise. Cite the Cognizant and Snowflake deals as external validation. Position agency deliverables produced on Claude (with proper audit logs) as a compliance advantage.

updates.title: Amazon Q2 2026: ad services revenue up 26% to $19.8B
updates.summary: Amazon reported Q2 2026 revenue of $200.6B on Jul 31 (+20% YoY) - first quarter above $200B. Ad services revenue grew 26% YoY to $19.8B. AWS $42.2B ($169B annualised run rate). EPS $5.75 (nearly 3x estimates). CEO Andy Jassy credited AI tools, conversational shopping and multi-sport streaming for ad growth.
updates.action: Amazon Ads at 26% growth is now the strongest of the big-three ad platforms. For ecom clients, sponsored products and DSP should be pushed harder - the ad engine is compounding faster than Google Search. Prime Video ads inventory is now scaled enough for CTV plans to include it alongside Netflix/Roku.

updates.title: Reddit launches Shopping Listing Ads (alpha) and Shopify GA at Q2 earnings
updates.summary: Alongside Q2 earnings on July 30, Reddit announced Shopping Listing Ads in alpha and general availability of its expanded Shopify integration, letting merchants launch Reddit campaigns rapidly from their existing product catalog. Tailored Creative Assets (headline/image combos recommended by community engagement patterns) and the Free-form Ad Generator (long-form Reddit-post-inspired creative) are also live in beta, both powered by Reddit Community Intelligence.
updates.action: For DTC/ecom clients on Shopify, add Reddit to the platform mix in Q3 as a test. Product-catalog-based launch removes the biggest historic Reddit friction (creative time to first campaign). Test Tailored Creative Assets against manually written variants to see how much the community-intelligence signal actually adds.

updates.title: Reddit Q2 2026 ad revenue up 64% YoY to $762M, active advertisers +70%
updates.summary: Reddit's Q2 2026 earnings (reported July 30) showed advertising revenue of $762M, up 64% YoY, driven by pricing and impressions growth. Total revenue $805M (+61%), net income $253M ($1.25 diluted EPS vs $0.45 prior year), eighth consecutive quarter of 60%+ growth, adjusted EBITDA margin 43%. Active advertisers +70% YoY. Scaled-channel (mid-market/SMB) revenue doubled. Reddit Max advertisers grew 60% QoQ and revenue jumped 150% sequentially. Dynamic Product Ads and app-install objectives both more than doubled. Machine-learning improvements: 6-second video view-through +130%, video completion +71%, CTR +40%. However, shares fell 12-21% post-earnings on US DAU slowdown concerns.
updates.action: Reddit is proving it can monetize the mid-market at scale. If a client has been holding off Reddit for lack of scaled tooling, the Q2 evidence (DPA + app-install doubling, Reddit Max sequential growth) justifies revisiting for lower-funnel plays. Watch AI search referral risk as counterweight.

updates.title: Advantage+ hits $75B annual run rate, Meta touts fastest ad growth
updates.summary: On the Q2 call Zuckerberg said 'On a dollar basis, our ads business is reporting faster year-over-year revenue growth than any other company's reported ad business.' Advantage+ platform hit a $75B annual revenue run rate. Meta also introduced the Meta Generative Recommender - LLM-based ad-to-user matching. Q3 guidance of $61-64B flagged EU personalization headwinds.
updates.action: The Advantage+ run rate confirms the mode is now Meta's default recommendation, not a bolt-on. For any Meta client not yet on Advantage+ Shopping or Advantage+ Leads, run a 30-day parallel test in Q3 - platform is optimizing for these formats.

updates.title: Meta Q2 2026: ad revenue up 27% to $59.4B, price per ad +12%
updates.summary: Meta reported Q2 2026 on July 29-30: total revenue $60.8B (+28% YoY), ad revenue $59.36B (+27%), impressions +14%, price per ad +12%. DAP hit 3.60B. EPS $6.18 missed the $7.22 estimate due to $2.4B legal charges + $1.18B severance from an 8,000-employee cut. Stock fell ~9.6% after hours on capex guidance ($130-145B).
updates.action: Bake +12% price-per-ad into H2 forecasts. Explain to clients why Meta CPMs are rising even without competitive changes. If ROAS is flat, that's actually a good result at these auction costs.

updates.title: LinkedIn Revenue Up 12% in Microsoft Q4 FY26 Earnings
updates.summary: Microsoft reported Q4 FY26 (quarter ending June 30, 2026) results on July 29-30, 2026: total revenue $90.0B up 18%, with LinkedIn revenue up 12% (10% constant currency), primarily driven by Marketing Solutions. This is a step-up from the 9% full-year FY25 growth, showing continued acceleration in LinkedIn's ad business into the calendar Q3 planning window.
updates.action: For B2B media plans, use the 12% growth signal as evidence that LinkedIn ad inventory demand is still climbing - expect continued CPM pressure in Q3/Q4 2026 as budgets shift in. If your Q4 plan includes LinkedIn, lock rates and Reserved Ads inventory early rather than betting on late-quarter auction efficiency.

updates.title: Reddit Q2 2026: ad revenue up 64% to $762M, WAUq crosses 500M
updates.summary: Reddit reported Q2 2026 revenue of $805M on Jul 30, up 61% YoY. Advertising revenue rose 64% YoY to $762M. Net income $253M (31% margin) vs $89M year-ago. Adjusted EBITDA $343M (42.6% margin). DAUq +18% to 130.3M; WAUq +24% to 514.6M. Reddit Max campaigns hit general availability with advertiser count +60% QoQ and revenue +150% QoQ.
updates.action: Reddit is now the fastest-growing major ad platform - 64% ad rev growth outpaces every peer. Push B2B and considered-purchase clients to open Reddit test budgets now while auction density is still low. Reddit Max (their Advantage+ equivalent) is worth a real trial. US user softness is the one red flag - non-US targeting is safer for scale.

updates.title: Meta Q2 2026: ad revenue $59.4B, impressions +14%, price/ad +12%
updates.summary: Meta reported Q2 2026 revenue of $60.8B on Jul 30 (+28% YoY). Advertising revenue was $59.4B. Ad impressions delivered +14% YoY, average price per ad +12% YoY. Reality Labs lost $4.6B (rev $431M, +16%). Capex more than doubled to $31.1B from $17B YoY, squeezing free cash flow to $784M.
updates.action: Meta ad prices up 12% - clients on flat budgets are effectively cutting reach. Push for either budget uplift or aggressive creative refresh to protect CPA. The impression volume growth (+14%) means auction supply is expanding; leaning into Advantage+ campaigns is where Meta's AI capex is flowing back to advertisers.

updates.title: Amazon Q2 2026 ad revenue up 26% to $19.8B, part of first $200B revenue quarter
updates.summary: Amazon reported Q2 2026 results on July 30, 2026: total net sales $200.6B (+20% YoY, first-ever $200B quarter), operating income $27.5B (+43%). Advertising services revenue reached $19.8B, up 26% YoY, powered by AI tools, conversational shopping, and multi-sport streaming. AWS grew 37% (fastest in 18 quarters) to $42.2B. Amazon Ads growth commentary from CEO Andy Jassy cited Rufus prompt monetization, Prime Video sports inventory sold-out status, and DSP AI enhancements.
updates.action: The 26% ad growth confirms Amazon Ads is now a genuine third pillar next to Google and Meta for retail-heavy brands. Any brand with a shoppable product should have Sponsored Products live and Rufus prompt readiness (backend keywords, A+ Content, review quality) audited. Prime Video CTV inventory scarcity means the sponsorship-tier prices will keep rising.

updates.title: Microsoft FY26 Q4: Azure crosses $100B, Copilot paid seats hit 30M
updates.summary: Microsoft reported $90B in FY26 Q4 revenue on Jul 29 (+18% YoY). Azure annual revenue crossed $100B for the first time. Intelligent Cloud $39.3B (+32%). Personal Computing (Bing, Surface, Windows, Xbox) $12.85B (-4.4%). Microsoft 365 Copilot passed 30M paid seats (up from 20M in April). GitHub Copilot at 50M users. LinkedIn: 20,000+ companies use AI recruiting products, seats +140% QoQ.
updates.action: LinkedIn AI recruiter seat growth of 140% QoQ signals the platform is becoming AI-native fast - B2B clients using LinkedIn Ads should test the newer AI-optimised audience products before competitors bid up CPMs. Bing/Copilot ads inventory is quietly growing while everyone talks ChatGPT - consider a small allocation there.

updates.title: Similarweb: ChatGPT share of AI web traffic drops from 76% to 53%
updates.summary: Similarweb's July 29, 2026 report shows ChatGPT's share of worldwide generative AI web traffic slid from ~76% a year ago to ~53%, while Gemini climbed past 25% and Claude became the fastest-growing platform. AI referral traffic has grown 9.9x in 19 months with ChatGPT still accounting for 92.4% of it. Semrush reports AI-referred visitors are more engaged and more likely to convert than standard web visits.
updates.action: Add Gemini and Claude to every GEO/AI-visibility monitoring workflow — ChatGPT-only tracking now misses nearly half the AI-answer market. For B2B clients, prioritize Claude visibility (developer/knowledge-worker skew); for B2C, prioritize Gemini (Google-user overlap). Rebuild the AI-visibility scorecard on Similarweb's tri-source distribution, not ChatGPT alone.

updates.title: TikTok launches TopView Geo Exclusion, blocks up to 40% of regions in national buys
updates.summary: TikTok's Q3 2026 product preview introduced TopView Geo Exclusion, letting advertisers run national TopView campaigns while excluding up to 40% of sub-regions (states, cities, DMAs). Same release moved TopView booking, order management, and creative rejection appeals directly into TikTok Ads Manager as a self-serve flow for select markets on allowlist. The eight-part update also covered premium reservation buys, catalog automation, commerce bidding, contextual inventory, generative creative, and agent tooling.
updates.action: If a client has state-specific promo calendars, blackout obligations, or restricted inventory (alcohol, regulated categories), request TopView Geo Exclusion allowlist access. Self-serve TopView also removes the rep-routed booking friction for reservation buys.

updates.title: Microsoft Advertising activates Ad Preview Hub inside Performance Max
updates.summary: Microsoft Ads Liaison Navah Hopkins announced on July 28, 2026 that the Ad Preview Hub is now live inside Performance Max campaigns. Advertisers open an asset group, click Preview ads, then filter by publisher (MSN, Bing Search, Outlook), device (computer, smartphone), asset and extension to see how automatically assembled creative will render before spend starts. A secure shareable link lets stakeholders review without account access.
updates.action: Before launching any new Microsoft PMax campaign for a client, run every asset group through the Ad Preview Hub and export the shareable link into the pre-launch approval doc. This closes the biggest visibility gap Microsoft PMax had vs. Google.

updates.title: Meta signs EU AI Act Code of Practice on GenAI transparency
updates.summary: Meta announced on July 28 that it will sign the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content. Reinforces the direction of the July C2PA auto-detection rollout for AI-generated ads. Compliance layer is now formal in the EU.
updates.action: For EU-serving accounts, treat AI-generated ad disclosure as non-negotiable. Any creative touched by third-party AI tools (Firefly, DALL-E, Canva AI) will auto-label - warn clients whose brand voice depends on non-labeled creative.

updates.title: Muse Image begins rolling into Advantage+ Creative in Q3
updates.summary: Meta's July 7 Muse Image announcement flagged Advantage+ Creative integration 'in the coming weeks' - the rollout began building in late July. Muse Image ranks No. 2 on Arena for text-to-image and multi-image editing; replaces the older AI creative stack that had quality issues. Handles complex prompts, legible text-in-image, and direct image markup.
updates.action: Re-run any June Advantage+ Creative tests once Muse Image lands in your accounts - the old model's failure modes (bad text, weird faces, off-brand backgrounds) should be substantially reduced. Build a new brief template that leans on Muse's text-in-image strength.

updates.title: Omnicom Media Group wins adidas $512M global media account
updates.summary: Omnicom Media Group won the final pitch for adidas' $512M global media account in July 2026, beating WPP and Publicis Groupe. Follows Omnicom's completed IPG acquisition (Nov 2025) making it the world's largest agency holding company at $17.3B revenue. Publicis countered earlier this cycle with a $2.55B LiveRamp acquisition and picked up Lotame.
updates.action: Big-brand pitches are re-consolidating - agencies with real first-party data infrastructure (Publicis via LiveRamp, Omnicom via IPG's Acxiom) are winning. For mid-market agencies, the counter-play is depth in a niche (vertical expertise, creative craft) not chasing full-funnel platform breadth. Position accordingly in pitches.

updates.title: Google Ads alcohol policy expands to 29 new countries
updates.summary: Effective July 28, 2026, Google Ads expanded its Alcohol policy to allow sale and informational promotion of alcoholic beverages in 29 additional countries including Brazil, South Korea, Vietnam (<5.5%), Finland, Croatia, Ecuador (<5%), Iceland (<2.25%), Slovenia, Serbia, Jamaica and 19 African markets. Promotion is limited to the maximum ABV permitted per region plus 0% ABV beverages.
updates.action: If any client sells alcohol or 0% alternatives (or plans to enter these markets), flag the new geographic allowances and check whether existing campaigns can now expand targeting. Confirm ABV caps per market before turning geo-expansion on.

updates.title: Anthropic ships enterprise admin analytics, model entitlements, spend alerts
updates.summary: Anthropic added enterprise-grade admin analytics, model-level entitlements, and spend alerts to Claude Enterprise in late July 2026, along with support for the new MCP 2026-07-28 spec that adds stateless core, OAuth/OIDC auth, and connector features like embedded UI and private network tunnels. These changes reflect Claude's shift from a chat tool to agentic work runner where usage and cost patterns are wildly different from typical chat.
updates.action: Any agency running Claude Enterprise across a team should turn on model-level entitlements to lock expensive models (Fable 5) to senior staff and route junior work to Sonnet 5/Opus 5. Set per-workspace spend alerts before month-end to catch runaway agent loops. If clients pay for Claude, add these controls to their onboarding checklist.

updates.title: MCP 2026-07-28 spec goes stateless — biggest protocol update since launch
updates.summary: Anthropic and the MCP working group shipped the 2026-07-28 specification release candidate on July 28, 2026 with the biggest changes since MCP launched twenty months ago. The protocol transitions from bidirectional stateful to a stateless request/response core, adds hardened OAuth/OIDC auth, a formal 12-month deprecation policy, and graduates server-rendered UI and long-running async tasks into official extensions. Community MCP servers for Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, Salesforce, and HubSpot are expected next.
updates.action: Audit every MCP server the agency uses (Meta Ads MCP, Google Ads MCP, nano-banana MCP) for compatibility with the new stateless core before the SDK's deprecate the old one. Start building an internal MCP-first campaign automation layer — the stateless model plus OAuth make production-safe writes to ad platforms viable for the first time.

updates.title: Household income exclusions spotted inside Performance Max
updates.summary: Paid search consultant Thomas Eccel surfaced a household income exclusion setting inside a European Performance Max campaign on July 24, 2026. Options include top 10%, 11–20%, 21–30%, 31–40%, 41–50%, lower 50%, and unknown. This is the first campaign-level income control PMax has offered since launch — Google has not formally announced it and rollout appears limited.
updates.action: Check PMax campaign settings for the new income exclusion tile — if visible, use it on premium-priced accounts to strip the lower income tiers that Search/Display advertisers already exclude. If not visible yet, note the intent and check weekly; treat this as expected rollout, not a rumour.

updates.title: ChatGPT Ads adds conversion bidding, geo exclusions, bulk campaign API
updates.summary: OpenAI shipped eight new ChatGPT Ads features in late July 2026 including optimized-cost-per-click (oCPC) conversion bidding under the Conversions objective, geo exclusions, AppsFlyer and Adjust integrations, and a bulk campaign API. Product feed campaigns now show product cards with pricing and star ratings. This closes the feature gap with mature ad platforms and makes ChatGPT Ads viable for performance advertisers, not just experimental brand tests.
updates.action: For any client already running ChatGPT ads tests, switch from max-clicks to Conversions objective with oCPC now that it exists. Set up AppsFlyer or Adjust postbacks so you can measure LTV, not just clicks. Use geo exclusions to fence out regions with weak ChatGPT install base.

updates.title: TikTok Symphony July 2026 update consolidates Agent, Creative Studio, and Content Suite
updates.summary: TikTok published a July 2026 Symphony update that folds every AI creative change rolled out since TikTok World '26 (May) into one workspace. Includes Symphony Agent (trend-driven video generation), Creative Studio (Dreamina Seedance 2.0 for text-to-video), Symphony Assistant (script writing and brief building), and campaign automation via Smart+. Reported 50-70% cut in production time and 80%+ usable first-pass outputs from creators on the model.
updates.action: For clients running TikTok Ads, test Symphony for at least one variant per creative concept in the next flight. The tool is free to all TikTok advertisers globally. Use human-shot content as the primary and Symphony-generated as complements, per TikTok's own guidance that shoppers are wary of pure AI ads.

updates.title: TikTok tells sellers to put real humans back on camera as AI-ad fatigue grows
updates.summary: In July 2026 industry coverage tied to TikTok's Q3 product update and its Symphony/Dreamina AI rollouts, TikTok itself advised advertisers to prioritize human-on-camera content because shoppers have grown suspicious of AI-generated ads. This shift is notable because TikTok is simultaneously pushing AI creative tooling — the message is that AI belongs in variants and adaptation, not primary hero content. Ties to broader ad-industry warning signs about AI overuse in creative.
updates.action: In any TikTok creative brief, lock at least 50-60% of primary variants as human-shot UGC or creator content. Use Symphony/AI only for hook variants, aspect ratio adaptation, localization, or lower-priority slots. Watch performance separately between AI-primary and human-primary cohorts.

updates.title: Meta AI Doesn't Just Think, It Acts - agentic capabilities expand
updates.summary: Meta Newsroom post (July 24) detailed Meta AI's shift from chat to agentic tool use - executing actions across search, coding, and image editing. Ties into the Muse Image rollout and the Business Agent platform. Signals the direction advertisers should expect for creative and lead workflows in H2 2026.
updates.action: Start briefing clients that Meta's ad workflows will keep moving toward agent-executed tasks (creative gen, lead qualification, catalog matching). Audit which manual steps in current campaigns are candidates for handoff.

updates.title: LinkedIn Introduces GIF Comments and Renames Easy Apply to LinkedIn Apply
updates.summary: In July 2026, LinkedIn added GIF support to comments (matching functionality already common on X, LinkedIn's slower rollout aimed at professional context), renamed the Easy Apply job flow to LinkedIn Apply, and began testing a Suggested Feeds feature that groups content by topic or interest. Small polish updates but signal continued push to lift engagement time in-feed.
updates.action: Low direct marketing impact but worth noting: GIF comments increase throwaway engagement volume and may shift LinkedIn's 360Brew ranking model away from surface-level comment counts (already the direction the algorithm was heading). Do not build organic strategy around comment volume alone - the model reads comment quality and context.

updates.title: eMarketer: US CTV upfront ad spend to exceed primetime linear in 2026
updates.summary: eMarketer forecasts US CTV upfront ad spend at $17.73B in 2026, overtaking primetime linear TV upfront spend of $16.98B for the first time. Total US CTV ad spend projected at $37.95B in 2026 (+15% YoY). Growth expected to hold at ~14% in 2026, cooling to ~11% through 2029 when the market reaches $51B.
updates.action: Structural shift is done: buyers who still frame CTV as a linear add-on are behind the market. For agency planning, treat CTV as the default video reach medium and linear as the supplement. Push clients to re-baseline their video mix based on cost-per-completed-view, not cost-per-GRP.

updates.title: Google Ads requires second-admin approval for sensitive changes
updates.summary: Google Ads began rolling out Multi-Party Approval (MPA) on July 24, 2026 with enforcement from July 27. Adding or removing users, or changing user roles, now requires a second administrator to approve the request. Applies only to accounts with more than three admins; requests expire after 20 days if no admin acts. Solo-admin accounts have no documented fallback.
updates.action: Audit admin counts across the RS and Yamu MCCs today — anywhere that runs at 4+ admins now needs a defined approver pair. For solo-admin client accounts, add a second trusted admin before the threshold expands so you don't get locked out of user changes later.

updates.title: SparkToro: 68% of US Google searches now end without a click
updates.summary: SparkToro's June 2026 study, updated in July, found 68.01% of US Google searches ended without a click in the first four months of 2026, up from 60.45% in 2024 — a 22.9% relative decline in click-through searches. Ahrefs trigger data cited in the study puts AI Overviews on 20%+ of all searches with a ~60% CTR drop when AIO fires. Google's AI Mode was only 0.34% of query volume in Jan-Apr 2026 but has since crossed 1 billion monthly users per Google I/O 2026.
updates.action: Bake this stat into every SEO pitch and QBR: 'Only 32% of Google searches send a click.' Add brand-mention KPIs (share of AI answers, share of citations) alongside classic organic-traffic goals. Push clients to fund content plays that get quoted in AIO — long-tail how-to, first-person data, industry-first stats — since citation now correlates with revenue better than blue-link rank.

updates.title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5 with effort-toggle for cost vs capability
updates.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026 — its fourth new model in under two months after Sonnet 5, Fable 5, and Mythos 5. Opus 5 sits at $5/M input and $25/M output tokens and comes close to Fable 5's frontier intelligence at half the price. Users can toggle effort (low/medium/high) per prompt to balance cost and capability. It is the new default on Claude Max, the strongest option on Claude Pro, and available in GitHub Copilot for long-running coding tasks.
updates.action: Move batch-heavy agency workflows (audits, campaign builds, keyword research summaries) from Fable 5 to Opus 5 low-effort mode to cut per-run cost 40-50% without dropping quality. Reserve Fable 5 for the final client-facing writing pass. Update tool routing in .claude/settings.json so cheap-lane tasks default to Opus 5.

updates.title: ChatGPT Enterprise adds real-time Voice in Chat and Voice in Work
updates.summary: OpenAI updated ChatGPT Enterprise and EDU on July 24, 2026 with a more natural ChatGPT Voice for workspaces, plus new Voice in Chat and Voice in Work on desktop so users can control tasks, coordinate agents, and keep long-running work moving in the background. Codex on desktop got voice control the same day. This is aimed at knowledge workers coordinating multiple ChatGPT Work agent runs at once.
updates.action: For agencies where writers/strategists already use ChatGPT Enterprise, test voice for the plan-and-brief phase of campaign work — 3-5 min voice briefings replace 30-45 min typed briefs for many use cases. Do NOT use voice for final client-facing drafts — it still amplifies filler words and hedging language the voice-check.js flags.

updates.title: Google Network ad revenue down 4% as AI Overviews squeezes open web
updates.summary: While Alphabet's Q2 2026 Search ads grew 17%, Google Network ad revenue (AdSense, AdMob, Ad Manager - third-party publishers) fell 4% YoY to $6.97B in Q1 2026 - the most direct signal yet that AI Overviews is compressing the open-web economy. Publisher traffic damage concentrates in informational organic clicks; commercial queries (ones with ads) continue monetising strongly.
updates.action: For clients with content-marketing budgets, treat informational-intent blog traffic as a declining asset - re-weight toward commercial-intent content that converts directly, and toward first-party channels (email, community, product-led). For publisher clients, AdSense/Ad Manager revenue projections should be haircut 5-10% for FY26 planning.

updates.title: HubSpot launches Agent Hub + Agent Builder in public beta
updates.summary: HubSpot released Agent Hub and Agent Builder on July 23, 2026 to Professional and Enterprise Smart CRM customers. Agent Hub gives teams one console to view, activate, and manage AI agents across marketing, sales, and service with live status and outcome-based grouping (build demand, win deals, delight customers). Agent Builder is a low-code canvas where non-technical staff assemble agents with their own prompts, knowledge, and CRM data. Prospecting Agent is now available to any paid Starter+ portal, not just Sales Hub.
updates.action: For every HubSpot client on Pro or Enterprise, turn on Agent Hub this week and audit which built-in agents fit their funnel. Prospecting Agent alone can replace an SDR seat for early-stage clients. Do not build custom agents from scratch — start from the HubSpot templates, then customize prompts and CRM knowledge sources.

updates.title: California WARN filings confirm 2,525 Meta layoffs effective July 22
updates.summary: California WARN Act filings triggered by Meta's May 2026 restructuring took effect July 22, 2026: 2,212 employees in Menlo Park and 313 in Sunnyvale separated. Severance = 16 weeks + 2 weeks per year of service. Part of the wider 8,000-role cut Meta booked $1.18B for in Q2. Also flagged: 6,000 planned hires cancelled, 7,000 roles reassigned to AI workflows.
updates.action: For any brand relying on a specific Meta account rep, verify continuity. Reassignments to 'AI workflows' can mean rep-facing partner teams thin out further in Q3 - lean harder on documented processes and self-serve tooling.

updates.title: OpenAI opens 'Advertise in ChatGPT' self-serve Ads Manager
updates.summary: On Jul 22 2026 OpenAI launched Advertise in ChatGPT - a self-serve platform where advertisers create campaigns, set budgets, and target by conversational context. Best Buy, Lowe's and VistaPrint were named launch advertisers. Ads show in 51% of US replies. Pricing: $3-5 CPC or $25-45 CPM. Free/Go plans in US, Canada, Australia, NZ see ads; Plus/Pro/Business remain ad-free.
updates.action: ChatGPT is now a real ad channel - not a research toy. Advise clients with high-intent B2B or considered-purchase products to run a $2-5K test in the first 60 days to lock early auction dynamics before CPCs harden. Conversational context targeting is different from keyword bidding: brief copy for the mid-answer placement, not the SERP.

updates.title: Alphabet Q2 2026: Google ads $81.6B (+14.5%), Search +17% despite AI Overviews
updates.summary: Alphabet reported Q2 2026 revenue of $119.8B on Jul 22, up 24% YoY. Google advertising rose 14.5% to $81.6B: Search $63.3B (+17%), YouTube ads $11.06B (+12.6%). Google Cloud jumped 82% to $24.77B. Alphabet raised 2026 capex guidance to $195-205B (from $180-190B). Search growth decelerated from 19% to 17% - first step-down of the AI Overviews era.
updates.action: Search ads still work in the AI Overviews world - commercial queries kept monetising. But the two-point deceleration is a shot across the bow. Push clients to lean into commercial-intent keywords (product/pricing/comparison), not top-of-funnel informational terms where AI Overviews eats clicks. YouTube ads is the safer growth vector this half.

updates.title: Google Ads API v25 released with YouTube Shorts metrics and new goals
updates.summary: Google announced Google Ads API v25 on July 22, 2026. Headline additions: YouTube Shorts engagement metrics now retrievable at six resource levels (AdGroup, AdGroupAd, Asset, Campaign, Customer, Video); a new retention-oriented goal type; and expanded objective management. Two lifecycle-goal resources were removed — breaking changes for existing client code.
updates.action: Notify any dev team or agency-side reporting stack pulling from the Google Ads API to schedule the v25 upgrade before v22 sunset. If clients ask about Shorts performance, this is the first version that exposes it at asset and ad-group grain in reports.

updates.title: Google Ads rolls out video campaign groups globally
updates.summary: Google announced global availability of video campaign groups on July 22, 2026. Advertisers can now group multiple YouTube video campaigns under a shared reach or frequency objective while keeping campaign-level budgets, creative and controls intact. Google's AI coordinates delivery across the group to cut audience overlap; Google's Meridian MMM study cited an optimal frequency of 2.7 exposures per week driving a 19% lift in ROI.
updates.action: For any client running two or more YouTube video campaigns, consolidate them into a video campaign group next planning cycle to remove double-serving. Target the 2.7/week frequency benchmark and pull the new unique reach report at the group level to show clients real net reach vs. gross impressions.

updates.title: Amazon Ads ships 10 new Brand+ and Performance+ capabilities, kills STV single-deal default
updates.summary: Amazon Ads announced 10 new capabilities across Brand+ and Performance+ on July 22, 2026. Highlights: (1) first-party audience data as free optimization input via Ads Data Manager for Brand+ Prospecting and Performance+ Customer Acquisition / Unified Consideration; (2) Audio for Brand+ GA in 16 locales plus third-party exchange supply; (3) Audio for Performance+ in open beta across 5 lower-funnel tactics; (4) Automatic Deal Selection now default on new Brand+ STV prospecting lines (single-deal STV buying removed); (5) Brand Outcome Optimization enabled by default; (6) Prime Video signal integration enabled by default; (7) Async Remarketing for Performance+ GA; (8) expanded conversion support for App Ads; (9) Proposal Builder GA for Amazon Media Group entities.
updates.action: For DSP clients: audit any active Brand+ STV prospecting lines — the single-deal default is gone and Auto Deal Selection is now on by default (this WILL change what inventory renders). For Performance+ clients with first-party audiences, enable Audience Signals immediately (free lift). Test audio for lower-funnel prospecting; 16-locale Brand+ audio unlocks non-US markets.

updates.title: OpenAI opens self-serve Ads Manager — Advertise in ChatGPT goes public
updates.summary: On July 22, 2026 OpenAI opened Advertise in ChatGPT, a self-serve Ads Manager where advertisers create campaigns, set budgets, and target ChatGPT users on conversational context rather than keywords. Sponsored blocks appear below ChatGPT responses served only to adult Free and Go users in the US, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand; Plus, Pro, and Business tiers remain ad-free. Best Buy, Lowe's, and VistaPrint were the launch advertisers. ChatGPT ads now appear in 51% of US replies.
updates.action: Open an OpenAI Ads Manager account for every client with a US B2C or high-consideration B2B ICP. Start budget at 5-10% of Google search spend as a test — conversational-context targeting means intent-heavy queries (comparison, research, buying research) get cheap early inventory. Build ChatGPT ad copy variants that lead with the AI-response context, not the keyword.

updates.title: AdBeacon flags 3 changes distorting July Meta ROAS reports
updates.summary: AdBeacon warned advertisers that three concurrent changes are inflating or deflating reported ROAS: off-platform opt-out removal (bigger retargeting pools = colder mix), EU location fees (2-5% invoice charges hidden from Ads Manager), and June 15 metric redefinitions (Media Views/Viewers replaced legacy reach). Month-over-month comparisons are unreliable without adjustment.
updates.action: Add a note to every July client report explaining the three measurement shifts. Rebase performance vs mid-June, not the pre-change baseline. For UK/EU spend, add a 2-5% CPA uplift line item.

updates.title: Google Ads caps in-account policy appeals at 6 months
updates.summary: Effective July 21, 2026, advertisers can no longer appeal a policy decision from inside a Google Ads account once the decision is more than 6 months old. The change shipped as a silent documentation update with no blog post or forum notice. After the window closes the only route is contacting Google Ads support, and no exception process has been disclosed.
updates.action: Audit every managed account for lingering disapprovals or account-level flags older than 5 months and file appeals now before they age out. Add a monthly recurring calendar check to catch new disapprovals inside the 6-month window.

updates.title: Google Ads adds Missed Opportunities beta to Recommendations tab
updates.summary: On July 21, 2026 Google moved the former Labs report to the main Recommendations tab, renamed it 'Missed Opportunities' and turned it on by default for all eligible advertisers. It estimates clicks, conversions and revenue lost over the last year to low bids or low budgets, and pairs every constrained campaign with an algorithmic bid or budget suggestion tied to auction data and seasonality.
updates.action: Open Recommendations in every managed account this week and screenshot the missed clicks, conversions and value totals. Use the split between 'low bids' and 'low budget' to prioritise which client conversations to raise first — this becomes a strong upsell narrative before the Aug 17 bidding change lands.

updates.title: Push Delivery to This Ad hits 100% of accounts
updates.summary: Meta's rollout tracker put Push Delivery to This Ad at nearly every ad account by mid-July 2026. Advertisers can dedicate a slice of ad-set budget to a specific ad for N days, forcing new creative to actually spend instead of being buried by an incumbent. First real manual delivery override Meta has shipped in years.
updates.action: Use it to force delivery on newly launched creative that isn't spending, or to timebox promo ads. Push for 3-5 days then let the algorithm resume normal delivery.

updates.title: Study: AI Overviews cut publisher clicks 39.8% with no drop in click quality
updates.summary: A peer-reviewed study published July 1, 2026 measured a 39.8% decrease in organic clicks when Google AI Overviews are shown. The study found no measurable difference in bounce rate, time on site, or return-to-search between AI Overview clicks and non-AIO clicks, meaning the lost traffic was NOT lower quality — publishers are losing genuinely valuable visits. Across major 2025-2026 studies AIO now appears on 15-25% of mixed-intent searches and 48-50% of informational queries.
updates.action: Rebuild the search-visibility story for every SEO client — organic CTR is dropping structurally, not because of a rank slip. Add a GEO/brand-mention line item to every SEO proposal. Pull an AIO impression report for every client account this month using the third-party trackers (Ahrefs, Similarweb) since GSC still under-reports AIO impressions.

updates.title: OpenAI ships GPT-5.6 to general availability alongside ChatGPT Work
updates.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5.6 on July 9, 2026 after a staggered government safety review. The model family (Luna, Terra, Sol) achieves state-of-the-art results on coding, knowledge work, cybersecurity, and science at lower estimated cost per token. GPT-5.6 is the operating brain for ChatGPT Work, which launched the same day and can gather context across apps, work in background for hours, and hand back finished spreadsheets, slide decks, reports, and web apps.
updates.action: Move production copywriter, campaign builder, and audit workflows to GPT-5.6. For agencies, test ChatGPT Work on client reports and slide decks — it can replace 2-3 hours of formatting per weekly ship. Pro, Enterprise, and Edu got Work first; Plus and Business rolled in over the following week.

updates.title: Off-platform data opt-out removed in US + 10 markets
updates.summary: Meta's July 2026 rollout retired the 'Your activity off Meta technologies' privacy control across the US, UK, Brazil and roughly ten other markets. Users who had previously disconnected off-Meta activity (purchases, add-to-carts, page views) are now visible again to retargeting and lookalike audiences. EU is exempt under GDPR - creates a two-tier system.
updates.action: Re-baseline July ROAS before comparing to prior months. Retargeting pools grew without any advertiser action - a colder mix can look like a performance dip. Warn clients that measurement, not creative, is causing the shift.

updates.title: Meta launches in-house Muse Image model for Advantage+ Creative
updates.summary: Meta released Muse Image on July 7, 2026, its first image generation model built entirely in-house by Meta Superintelligence Labs, ending reliance on Midjourney and Black Forest Labs. Muse Image rolls into Advantage+ Creative across ad accounts in Q3 2026 with agentic reasoning that parses a creative brief, adjusts individual elements, and produces on-brand variations. Meta reports Advantage+ Creative campaigns average 12% higher CTR than manually managed campaigns.
updates.action: Do not turn off Advantage+ Creative image enhancements. Re-test static ad variants generated with Muse against your best manual creatives; any June creative tests are now stale. Rebuild your Meta creative benchmark using Muse-powered variants before Q4 planning.

updates.title: Netflix Q2 Revenue Up 13% With Ad Business Path to $3B
updates.summary: Netflix Q2 2026 revenue hit $12.6B, up 13.4% YoY. Ad business on track for approximately $3B in 2026 (double 2025). Ad tier reaches 190M monthly viewers; over 60% of new subscribers in ad-tier markets choose ad-supported. Advertiser base up 70% to 4,000+.
updates.action: For CTV budgets, Netflix now qualifies for lower-funnel testing thanks to advertiser scale. Buy via TTD, DV360, Yahoo DSP, or Amazon DSP (US launched Q2).

updates.title: Netflix Q2 2026: ad tier hits 250M MAU, ad rev on track for $3B FY26
updates.summary: Netflix reported Q2 2026 revenue of $12.56B on Jul 16 with EPS of $0.80. The ad-supported tier reached 250M+ global monthly active viewers (up from 190M), with more than half of new sign-ups now choosing the ads plan. Q2 ad revenue landed near $666M; Netflix reiterated it is on track for ~$3B ads revenue in 2026.
updates.action: CTV/streaming plans should treat Netflix as a real reach channel now, not a test. The ads plan is the majority sign-up path, so audience scale is genuine. Push clients with US/UK/Canada targets to move a slice of CTV budget from Roku/YouTube into Netflix upfront or biddable inventory before pricing tightens.

updates.title: Publicis Raises 2026 Guidance After Q2 Organic Growth 4.8%
updates.summary: Publicis reported Q2 net revenue up 4.8% organically (Q1 was 4.5%), with H1 revenue at 3,769M euros. Company raised 2026 organic growth guidance to 4.5-5.0% from 4.0-5.0%. US delivered 5.5% organic growth on 58% of revenue. Headline operating margin hit a record 17.5%.
updates.action: Use Publicis' raised guidance as a leading indicator that agency-holding demand is holding through H2. Reference in client budget defence when finance teams cite macro softness.

updates.title: Google Ads AI Max rollout gets July control update, DSA sunset delayed to Feb 2027
updates.summary: Google shipped a July 2026 update giving AI Max more control over campaign management as it moves through a phased rollout. Auto-upgrade for Automatically Created Assets (ACA) and campaign-level broad match starts September 2026. Dynamic Search Ads auto-upgrade to AI Max was DELAYED from September 2026 to February 2027. Google's own data shows AI Max campaigns average 7% more conversions or conversion value at similar CPA/ROAS when the full feature suite (search-term matching, text customization, final URL expansion) is enabled.
updates.action: Do not opt DSAs into AI Max early — you now have until Feb 2027 and account-specific data on DSA-to-AI-Max migration is limited. For non-DSA search campaigns, enable full AI Max feature suite in a controlled test versus a paired holdout to validate the 7% lift claim on YOUR account before September auto-upgrade.

updates.title: LinkedIn API Version 202507 Sunsets July 15, 2026
updates.summary: LinkedIn's rolling API version sunset schedule retired version 202507 on July 15, 2026, with 202508 (Aug 17) and 202509 (Sep 15) queued next. Integrations still calling deprecated versions will fail once sunset. LinkedIn currently supports a 12-month version window for the Marketing API.
updates.action: Audit every LinkedIn API integration (custom reporting, Zapier flows, in-house dashboards, agency partner tools) for hardcoded version strings. Bump to 202607 to pick up the new SHA256_IP_ADDRESS field + Predictive Audience id support at the same time. Do not wait until an integration silently breaks mid-quarter.

updates.title: Amazon Removes Featured Offer Pass Fail Gate July 20
updates.summary: Starting July 20 in EU/UK, rolling to US and global by year-end, Amazon collapses the two-step Featured Offer (Buy Box) eligibility into one blended scoring system. ODR, VOC, and chargebacks now sit inside a single ranking calculation alongside price and delivery speed, with undisclosed formula weights.
updates.action: For Amazon seller clients, audit ODR/VOC/chargeback metrics because they now directly affect Sponsored Products impression share via Buy Box wins. Prioritise operational improvements before global rollout.

updates.title: Markifact ships hosted Google Ads MCP server with human-approved writes
updates.summary: Markifact announced global availability of its hosted Google Ads MCP server on July 13, 2026, providing read plus write capabilities to complement Google's official read-only MCP server (open-sourced October 2025). Writes require human approval before execution, matching the pattern our own tools/google-ads-api uses. Any change from an LLM must be reviewed before it hits the account.
updates.action: For agencies without in-house Google Ads write tooling, Markifact's hosted server is a lower-friction alternative than building on the Google Ads gRPC API directly. Test on a small non-critical account first. Keep the human-approval gate mandatory — do not let Claude/ChatGPT push structural changes to live campaigns unattended.

updates.title: EU Commission Charges Meta Over Addictive Design Under DSA
updates.summary: The EU Commission published preliminary findings on July 10 targeting Meta over infinite scroll, video autoplay, push notifications, and personalized algorithmic recommendation feeds under DSA health rules. This is the Commission's third major 2026 DSA enforcement event against a social/marketplace platform.
updates.action: Flag potential downstream restrictions on personalisation for EU-targeted Meta campaigns to clients; monitor if the Commission demands feature changes that would degrade Advantage+ or lookalike modelling in EU markets.

updates.title: Google AI Ad Disclosure Labels Launch In My Ad Center
updates.summary: Google's July 9, 2026 launch of AI transparency labels adds a 'How this ad was made' panel inside My Ad Center describing whether an ad was created or edited with AI. The setting is being staged across Google Ads, DV360, CM360, Merchant Center and Ads Editor.
updates.action: Update client-facing documentation on how the label appears and prepare a talking track for the sales-versus-transparency question on hero creative.

updates.title: Google Rolls Out AI Ad Disclosure Labels Across Five Products
updates.summary: On July 9, 2026, Google began rolling out 'How this ad was made' disclosures in My Ad Center across Search, YouTube and Discover. Ads built with Google's generative AI get labeled automatically; ads built with third-party AI require advertisers to self-declare via a new checkbox.
updates.action: Add an 'AI-used' declaration step to every client creative sign-off and tick the disclosure box where third-party generative tools are involved, especially for EU, NY and India delivery.

updates.title: OpenAI Shuts Down ChatGPT Atlas Browser, Folds Agentic Browsing Into ChatGPT Work
updates.summary: On July 9, 2026, OpenAI announced it is deprecating the ChatGPT Atlas browser (launched Oct 2025) with a hard shutoff on August 9, 2026. Browser-based agentic capabilities move into ChatGPT and Codex under a new desktop product called ChatGPT Work - combining ChatGPT, Codex and agentic browsing. Multi-tab browsing, downloads, account login and improved navigation are added inside ChatGPT.
updates.action: For any client running Atlas-specific tests or integrations, cut over before Aug 9. Reframe the 'agentic browser as ad channel' thesis - the surface consolidates back into ChatGPT itself, so ChatGPT Ads is the single monetised entry point.

updates.title: LinkedIn Adds Video Covers for Articles and Newsletters
updates.summary: LinkedIn rolled out video covers for newsletters and articles in July 2026. Creators can add a horizontal 16:9 video (recommended under 30 seconds) that plays in the main feed and appears as a thumbnail in email delivery. Newsletter creators now also get email metrics (sends, open rate) alongside on-platform view counts.
updates.action: For B2B creators or client newsletters, swap static header images for a 15-30 sec video cover on the next issue and measure feed dwell + click lift vs the previous static baseline. Only worth the effort if your newsletter distribution is a real acquisition channel - low-volume newsletters do not justify the video production cost.

updates.title: LinkedIn Sponsored Content CPC Rises to $5.74 Cross-Industry
updates.summary: 2026 benchmark data shows LinkedIn Sponsored Content CPC climbed from $5.26 (2024) to $5.74 across all industries, a 9% YoY increase. Legal ($7.95) and financial services ($6.84) sit at top; education ($4.18) and nonprofit ($3.12) at bottom. Native Lead Gen Forms hold a 6.1% CVR average, roughly 5x off-platform LPs. Thought Leader Ads deliver ~2.68% median CTR at $2.29 CPC vs 0.42% CTR and $13.23 CPC for single-image ads.
updates.action: Reset client CPL targets against the 2026 benchmark, not 2024. Push more spend toward Thought Leader Ads if the client has any executive or SME posting cadence - the ~6x CTR / ~6x lower CPC gap versus single-image is the strongest lever on LinkedIn right now. Keep Native Lead Gen Forms as the default conversion action.

updates.title: IAB Australia: 60% of buyers increased retail media investment in H1 2026
updates.summary: IAB Australia's State of the Nation report (released Jul 7 2026) found 60% of buy-side respondents increased retail media investment, with nearly half fully reallocated from other channels. 93% of retail/commerce media networks reported onsite revenue growth; 89% saw it translate to in-store growth. 56% keep trade and media budgets separate. 80% said IAB certification would increase willingness to partner. Only 22% of networks describe their offering as 'advanced'.
updates.action: Retail media budgets are being taken FROM other channels, not added on top - if a client sells through retailers, they should be evaluating an RMN allocation or losing shelf-share to competitors that are. For non-endemic brands, RMN measurement is still weak - push retailers for onsite + in-store attribution before committing test budgets.

updates.title: Disney Advertising Closes Upfront With Sequential Storytelling Deal
updates.summary: Disney closed 2026 upfront negotiations with strong momentum across sports and streaming. Omnicom Media Group announced a Disney collaboration combining Disney's audience identity graph, Acxiom identity, Omni measurement, and Innovid creative sequencing for evolving-story ads across VOD and live. Disney also expanded Gateway Go, Pause Ads, and selectable ads on Disney+.
updates.action: For CTV-heavy clients, request Disney's sequential creative package for the next major campaign flight. Build creative in 3-5 story beats to leverage Innovid sequencing.

updates.title: Meta Updates AI Disclosure Tags on Facebook and Instagram Ads
updates.summary: On July 7, Meta rolled out updated disclosure labels for ads containing AI-generated content, moved from the three-dot menu into the 'About this ad' section. Auto-tagging applies when advertisers use Background Generation, Image Generation, or Add Animation. Third-party AI is detected via C2PA metadata industry standard.
updates.action: Update every client's ad-approval checklist to note when Meta's AI creative tools were used and confirm the auto-label matches. For political or health/finance verticals, add a review step to catch any surprise 'AI Info' tag that could dent trust with a conservative audience.

updates.title: Meta Introduces Muse Image, First Superintelligence Labs Image Model, to Advantage+
updates.summary: On July 7, Meta launched Muse Image - the first image generation model from Meta Superintelligence Labs. The agentic model parses a creative brief, adjusts individual elements, swaps styles, and creates on-brand variations with fewer iterations. Rolling out to advertisers and agencies through Advantage+ creative in the coming weeks.
updates.action: Prep client-brand style guides and reference-image libraries now so Muse Image variations have proper anchor material at rollout. This is the first model Meta specifically built for the Advantage+ workflow - early adopters will get better creative output than late testers who feed thin briefs.

updates.title: Amazon DSP Omnichannel Metrics adds retailer-level offline sales breakouts
updates.summary: Amazon Ads updated Omnichannel Metrics on July 7, 2026 to show retailer-level breakouts for offline purchases influenced by DSP campaigns. Previously advertisers saw aggregate off-Amazon sales; now they can identify which specific retailers captured the sales. Exposure-based attribution (credits sales to shoppers who saw ads, click not required). Data combines Amazon Shopper Panel first-party signals plus undisclosed third-party sources. US-only, DSP-only (excludes Sponsored Products/Brands/Display), available in both Self-Service and Managed Service.
updates.action: For any CPG or omnichannel retail client running Amazon DSP, request the retailer-level Omnichannel Metrics report. Materially changes retailer negotiations — can now prove Amazon DSP drove Walmart or Target sales specifically. Doesn't help Sponsored Products advertisers.

updates.title: Meta Launches Pocket AI Creative App for Interactive Content
updates.summary: On July 5, Meta launched Pocket, an AI-powered creative platform where users describe 'gizmos' - small interactive projects - through text prompts, and the AI generates them. The app includes a social feed for browsing community creations and aims to democratize interactive content creation without coding.
updates.action: Low direct ad relevance today, but track adoption as a potential future organic-to-paid surface. If Pocket picks up traction like Threads did, it could become a new distribution point for interactive creative within 6-12 months. Not a live ad opportunity yet.

updates.title: Reddit unveils Split Testing tool for controlled A/B tests in Ads Manager
updates.summary: Reddit launched Split Testing in Ads Manager on July 3, 2026, letting brands run controlled A/B tests with one variable changed and receive a winner declaration at 65% confidence. Audience is split at the user level and two flights run simultaneously. This is a more formal alternative to the ad-hoc testing patterns most Reddit advertisers used before.
updates.action: For any client already spending on Reddit, add at least one Split Test per flight (hook, image, or offer variable). The 65% confidence threshold is loose, so pair with real conversion data before scaling the winner. Free feature, no reason to skip it.

updates.title: TikTok expands Ads Manager AI Skills via Agentic Hub MCP marketplace
updates.summary: TikTok Agentic Hub, launched end of June 2026 and rolled into July advertiser access, is a marketplace inside Ads Manager where advertisers install AI Skills, MCP servers, and Agents to automate campaign creation, diagnosis, reporting, and catalog management. Initial partners include HubSpot, Wix, Constant Contact, WorkMagic, Innovid, Kochava, Shoplazza, and Mobvista. Advertisers can also build their own custom Skills. TikTok's MCP server predates equivalents from Pinterest and Snap by about a month.
updates.action: For agencies with tech-heavy clients, pilot at least one Agent via the Hub (creative rotation or diagnostics workflows are the easiest wins). Adds automation without full API build. Track which Skills materially move campaign performance vs which are marketing veneer.

updates.title: Meta Begins Passing Digital Service Taxes to Advertisers as Location Fees
updates.summary: Effective July 1, 2026, Meta charges 'location fees' of 2%-5% based on where ads are served: Austria and Turkey 5%, France, Italy and Spain 3%, UK 2%. Meta was the last major ad platform (after Google, Amazon, Apple) to absorb DST costs. Campaign budget optimization does not account for the fee, so invoiced totals can exceed set budgets.
updates.action: Update media plans and client-facing budget forecasts for every UK and EU-served campaign this week to include the 2-5% surcharge. VAT compounds on top of the location fee, so ecommerce clients in the UK are looking at effective +22% not +2%. Communicate to finance teams before invoicing hits.

updates.title: LinkedIn Reports Ads Personalization Lift: +1.4pt Conv, +2.4pt Video Lead Gen
updates.summary: As part of the July 1, 2026 creative tools release, LinkedIn published performance stats for its Ads Personalization tool (which adjusts creatives based on member job title, company, industry): +1.4 percentage points on Website Conversion campaigns and +2.4 points on Video Ads with Lead Generation objective. Flexible Ad Creation reportedly generates 7% more creative options per campaign. All numbers are vendor-stated internal data with no disclosed sample size or methodology.
updates.action: Treat LinkedIn's personalization uplift claims as a hypothesis, not a benchmark. Run a controlled test: identical audience and budget, one ad set with Personalization on and one off, 21+ day window, minimum 500 clicks per side before reading conversion. If your account is under 10k impressions/day, uplift may not surface within the test window.

updates.title: LinkedIn Marketing API v202607: SHA256 IP, Predictive Audience IDs, InMail Optimized Default
updates.summary: LinkedIn's July 2026 Marketing API release (version 202607) shipped three changes: (1) Conversions API now accepts SHA256_IP_ADDRESS as a hashed user identifier (IPv4 only) for improved match rates, (2) Predictive Audiences API returns a read-only id in single and list responses so partners can update audiences created in Campaign Manager, (3) Sponsored InMail Lead Gen campaigns now default creativeSelection to OPTIMIZED instead of rejecting the combination - integrations must explicitly set ROUND_ROBIN to keep even rotation.
updates.action: Audit any Conversions API integration and add SHA256_IP_ADDRESS alongside existing identifiers to lift match quality. Check every Sponsored InMail Lead Gen campaign create/update call - if you were not setting creativeSelection explicitly, rotation behavior just changed. Update predictive audience workflows to store the new id field for later API-based edits.

updates.title: LinkedIn Launches 5 AI Creative Tools in Campaign Manager (Self-Serve)
updates.summary: On July 1, 2026, LinkedIn rolled out five creative tools inside Campaign Manager for self-serve advertisers: Brand Kit (locks colors/fonts/tone for AI-generated assets), Draft with AI (generates ad copy from a URL + goal), Ads Personalization (adjusts creative by job title/company/industry), AI Ad Variants (spins headline and intro variations from one seed ad), and Flexible Ad Creation (mix-and-match assets into permutations). LinkedIn's internal data cites 20%+ higher CTR for campaigns running 5 or more variants vs a single ad.
updates.action: Test Draft with AI + AI Ad Variants to spin 5-8 creatives per ad set from a single approved brief. Lock Brand Kit first so voice does not drift. Treat LinkedIn's 20% CTR claim as a hypothesis - measure your own uplift over 14 days before scaling. Best fit for lean B2B teams without a dedicated design queue.

updates.title: LinkedIn Activates Five AI Creative Tools in Campaign Manager
updates.summary: On July 1, 2026 LinkedIn launched five AI tools inside Campaign Manager for SMB advertisers: Brand Kit (upload colors, fonts, logo, voice guidelines), Draft with AI (generates ads from URL + objective), AI Ad Variants (multi-version A/B testing), Ads Personalization (adapts creative to audience segments using title/company/industry), and Flexible Ad Creation (mix and match uploaded assets). LinkedIn data shows campaigns with 5+ ad variants outperform single-ad campaigns by 20%+ CTR.
updates.action: Load client brand assets into Brand Kit as the first setup step. For every new ad set, generate 5+ variants using AI Ad Variants and hold auction share constant so LinkedIn's algorithm can shift budget to winners. Verify AI-generated headlines pass the client voice check before launch.

updates.title: Three State Privacy Laws Take Effect July 1
updates.summary: Connecticut (amended CTDPA), Arkansas (Children/Teens' Online Privacy Protection Act), and Utah privacy amendments took effect July 1, 2026. CT threshold drops to 35,000 residents (or any volume for data sellers), adds neural data and LLM training disclosure. Arkansas bans targeted advertising for under-17s. Utah adds right to correction plus social data portability.
updates.action: Audit consent management and opt-out flows for all clients selling to under-17s (blocks targeted advertising in Arkansas). Update client privacy notices to include LLM training disclosure per CT.

updates.title: Amazon Marketing Cloud opens to all Sponsored Ads advertisers free, no SQL required
updates.summary: Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) is now accessible to any seller running Sponsored Ads campaigns via the self-service console — no dedicated data analyst or agency contract required. Confirmed in early July 2026 coverage. AMC 2026 additions include no-SQL guided workflows, Ads Agent, five-year lookback window (up from 13 months), Custom Models, APIs, and audience activation. Templates and guided workflows lower the bar for non-technical teams.
updates.action: Every Amazon Sponsored Ads advertiser should now spin up an AMC instance and run at least the New-to-Brand and cross-channel path templates. Five-year lookback lets you measure repeat-purchase economics you couldn't see before. Zero cost, so no reason to hold back.

updates.title: TikTok Launches Agentic Hub for AI-Powered Campaign Skills
updates.summary: TikTok's Agentic Hub went live June 30, 2026, giving advertisers a set of AI-powered Skills for campaign creation, creative generation, and catalog management routed through the Ads MCP integration.
updates.action: Assign one media buyer to build out an internal Agentic Hub playbook - start with catalog-management Skills for ecom accounts where the workflow is well-defined.

updates.title: Reddit Launches Brand Campaign Highlighting Community Contributors
updates.summary: Reddit launched (June 30, 2026) a brand campaign shouting out its 'greatest assets' - the redditors themselves who power the platform's community intelligence advertising pitch to marketers.
updates.action: Signal only - Reddit is publicly leaning into community-driven ad differentiation. Frame Reddit media plans around community credibility, not paid-social-parity tactics.

updates.title: Prime Video Ads Expand to Belgium Denmark Norway Turkey
updates.summary: Amazon announced Prime Video advertising expands to Belgium, Denmark, Norway, and Turkey in 2026, opening new markets for brands. Amazon quietly doubled ad load to 4-6 minutes per hour without public disclosure to subscribers, per third-party analysis.
updates.action: For brands with presence in the four new Prime Video ad markets, add Amazon Prime Video to 2027 CTV plans. Note higher ad-load reality when negotiating share-of-voice guarantees.

updates.title: Australian Regulator Sues Amazon Over Prime Video Ads Terms
updates.summary: The ACCC accused Amazon Australia of breaching consumer law over 'negative changes' to Prime subscription terms when it introduced Prime Video advertising, affecting 850,000+ subscribers. Case heads to Federal Court and is being watched internationally as precedent.
updates.action: For clients running Prime Video ads targeting APAC, monitor case outcome. May influence future ad-load disclosure requirements globally.

updates.title: Meta Cannes Study: $4.13 Downstream Revenue Per Ad Dollar, Up 25 Percent Since 2022
updates.summary: Meta presented a June 2026 study of 1M+ ad campaigns (run April 13-20, 2026) using a UC Berkeley / NBER academic framework, finding average $4.13 in downstream advertiser revenue per $1 of Meta ad spend, up 25% since 2022. Meta credits AI upgrades to ranking, delivery and outcome modeling. 8M+ advertisers now use Meta's generative AI creative tools.
updates.action: Use the $4.13 blended figure as the industry-average anchor in client QBRs and new-business pitches, but caveat that it is a Meta-stated benchmark not independently audited. Benchmark client ROAS against this to identify accounts underperforming Meta's own median.

updates.title: The Trade Desk Settles Publicis Dispute and Adds Commerce Media Partners
updates.summary: The Trade Desk resolved its dispute with Publicis in June, unlocking resumed agency spend, and announced commerce media expansion with Booking Holdings, Marriott Media, Uber Advertising, and United's Kinective Media. New CMO Sarah Gavin appointed and CRO Anders Mortenson exited.
updates.action: For clients using TTD, note the commerce/travel integration widens targetable inventory. For agencies with Publicis clients, note the truce restores TTD as a viable buying option.

updates.title: Havas Play Acquires Youth Culture Agency Archrival
updates.summary: Havas acquired a majority stake in Archrival, a US youth-culture and experiential activation agency, to expand Havas Play's sports marketing, live experiences, branded partnerships, creator engagement, and experiential activation. Archrival's client roster includes Disney, Adidas, Red Bull, Netflix, Snapchat, Spotify, Tinder, Amazon, and EA.
updates.action: For brands targeting Gen Z with experiential or creator work, Archrival is now a Havas-network capability. Watch for pitched cross-sell with Havas Media buys.

updates.title: Google Ads API v24.2 Adds AI Transparency And Multi-Party Approvals
updates.summary: Released June 24, 2026, Google Ads API v24.2 introduces SyntheticContentInfo/Attestation fields for AI-generated creative aligned with the EU AI Act, multi-party approval for sensitive account actions, PMax placement segmentation by network type, and two new experiment types.
updates.action: Ask engineering to upgrade internal reporting scripts to v24.2 and enable Multi-Party Approvals on agency-managed accounts for user invitations and access changes.

updates.title: Meta Outlines Best Practices for AI-Generated Multimedia Ads
updates.summary: On June 24, Meta published new guidance recommending advertisers upload up to 10 images and videos per ad, mixing asset types (image plus video) and aspect ratios (1:1, 9:16) within a single ad instead of splitting into multiple ads. Meta's delivery system then AI-optimizes which creative variation runs in each placement.
updates.action: Rebuild the ad-creation template used across client accounts to consolidate ad units. Every new ad should ship with at least 3-4 image variants plus one video, mixed ratios. This aligns with Meta's push toward Advantage+ Creative and unlocks more placement inventory per ad.

updates.title: IAB Tech Lab Opens SupplyChain v1.1 for Public Comment
updates.summary: IAB Tech Lab announced SupplyChain v1.1, a proposed upgrade to the OpenRTB SupplyChain Object designed to strengthen transparency in the open internet. Public comment period runs until August 21, 2026. Follows earlier 2026 releases of GPP bi-annual cycle and Data Deletion Request Framework v2.
updates.action: SSP/DSP-heavy clients should log the comment period and evaluate whether their supply partners will meet v1.1 disclosures at go-live.

updates.title: Meta Unifies Creator Marketplace and Partnership Ads Hub Into Creator Marketing Hub
updates.summary: Announced at Cannes Lions on June 23, Meta is merging the Creator Marketplace (5M+ Instagram creators) and Partnership Ads Hub into a single Meta Creator Marketing Hub. It adds Facebook creators for the first time and lets marketers move from creator discovery to activation as partnership ads in one surface. Rollout later in 2026.
updates.action: For clients running influencer or partnership ads on Meta, pause any tool builds that duplicate Marketplace/Partnership functionality - the merger will make cross-platform creator sourcing native. Start compiling a creator shortlist including Facebook now to be ready at rollout.

updates.title: Meta Debuts End-to-End Creative Suite and WPP Integration at Cannes
updates.summary: On June 23 at Cannes Lions, Meta launched a new end-to-end AI creative solution in Ads Manager with brand-aware creative generation, brand memory that learns tone from past ads, enhanced text generation, multi-language translations, and a creative approval workflow. WPP is the first agency partner, integrating the tools into WPP Open.
updates.action: Book time on the new creative solution's tools tab for at least two clients this month - Meta cites $4.13 in downstream revenue per $1 spent in a 1M-campaign study. Test brand memory by uploading top-performing prior ads and reviewing whether AI variations hold voice.

updates.title: Google Delays Dynamic Search Ads Migration To AI Max Until February 2027
updates.summary: On June 23, 2026, Google confirmed that the automatic upgrade of DSA campaigns to AI Max is postponed from September 2026 to February 2027, and restored the ability to create new DSA campaigns from June 15. ACA and campaign-level broad match still transition in September.
updates.action: Keep DSAs running where they are performing and use the extra runway to A/B DSA vs AI Max on a matched budget before the forced February 2027 cutover.

updates.title: TikTok Unveils Symphony Agent at Cannes Lions 2026
updates.summary: TikTok launched Symphony Agent on June 22, 2026 at Cannes Lions - an agentic AI chat interface across Symphony Creative Studio, Content Suite, and TikTok One that generates TikTok-first video ads, sorts existing creator content by AI search, and streamlines creator discovery.
updates.action: Creative teams should pilot Symphony Agent for first-cut concepting on new briefs and for scaling existing creator content that already tests well - not for finished-craft output.

updates.title: Reddit Rolls Out Community Intelligence Ad Suite at Cannes 2026
updates.summary: On June 22, 2026 Reddit announced a four-product Community Intelligence ad suite: Conversation Summary Add-Ons (generally available), Shopping List Ads (first multi-advertiser format), Reddit Insights AI social listening, and a free-form Reddit-native ad generator. Early tests showed Conversation Summary Add-Ons drove a 19% higher CTR than standard image ads.
