updates.action: Enable Conversation Summary Add-Ons on any eligible Reddit conversion campaign - it is a no-cost creative upgrade with a documented CTR lift. Add Reddit Insights to any social listening or research task before writing net-new copy.

updates.title: Reddit Debuts Free-Form AI Ad Generator Tuned to Subreddit Voice
updates.summary: As part of the June 22, 2026 Community Intelligence launch, Reddit introduced a free-form ad generator that uses a brand's website plus related Reddit conversations to suggest headlines and image variations tailored to specific subreddits and audience personas.
updates.action: Use the generator as a starting-point for community-specific variants rather than shipping direct - Reddit-native voice still needs human copy review to avoid the 'obvious brand ad' penalty in comments.

updates.title: Microsoft Ads Adds Disclaimer Assets For RSA, PMax And Audience Ads
updates.summary: In its June 22, 2026 product roundup, Microsoft rolled out a disclaimer feature for RSA, PMax and Audience ads with popup (up to 500 chars for Native) or inline layouts, and label options such as Disclaimer, Disclosure, Offer Details, Safety Information and Terms Apply.
updates.action: Add disclaimers to regulated-vertical clients (finance, health, travel) so legal fine print no longer eats headline/description characters.

updates.title: Meta Sunsets Nielsen DMA Targeting for Auto Ads, Replaces With Comscore Markets
updates.summary: As of June 22, 2026, Meta removed Nielsen's Designated Market Area (DMA) dimension from targeting and reporting. Automotive advertisers must now use comscore_market_codes in vehicle offer feeds instead of dma_codes. Campaigns still using DMA after the deadline are paused. Dashboards in Supermetrics, Triple Whale, and Northbeam had to be updated.
updates.action: Verify every US geo-targeted campaign is migrated to Comscore Markets - automotive accounts especially. Audit client reporting dashboards for any lingering DMA field references and swap to 'Comscore market'. Historical comparisons should be treated cautiously as boundaries differ slightly.

updates.title: Walmart Sets Global Commerce Media Vision at NewFronts
updates.summary: On June 22, Walmart Connect laid out its next-era global commerce media vision. Global advertising revenue grew 37% in the latest quarter with Walmart Connect US up 44% excluding VIZIO. Walmart Connect US reaches 150M+ weekly customers via omnichannel solutions.
updates.action: Update client retail media plans to reflect Walmart's 44% growth trajectory and its positioning as a full commerce media platform (not just onsite ads).

updates.title: Google Updates Target-Based Bidding For Budget-Limited Campaigns
updates.summary: On June 22, 2026, Google confirmed that from August 17 target-based bidding for budget-limited Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen and Travel campaigns will be pulled back toward stated CPA/ROAS targets. A Bid Target Adjustment Tool goes live July 6.
updates.action: Pull a list of every client campaign that is Limited by Budget with tCPA/tROAS, and use the July 6 tool to explicitly keep, match or reset targets before Aug 17.

updates.title: Amazon Rolls Out REC Conversational Prompts to Open Web
updates.summary: Amazon Ads updated Responsive eCommerce Creative (REC) on June 22. Starting July 2026, conversational prompts expand across the open internet via REC display ads. Shoppers on publisher sites see display ads with clickable product-specific questions drawn from PDPs, Brand Stores, and campaign data; tapping opens an Alexa for Shopping conversation.
updates.action: For Amazon DSP clients, refresh PDP copy, Brand Store content, and campaign data so conversational prompts pull the strongest phrases. Test REC display ads on open-web inventory when the July rollout completes.

updates.title: Snap Debuts Smart Assistant and Revamped Agentic Dynamic Product Ads
updates.summary: Snap announced on June 19, 2026 a slate of agentic advertising updates: Snap Smart Assistant (recommends campaign objectives, audience, optimization settings), a rebuilt Dynamic Product Ads engine with agentic recommendation models, AI background enhancement, and generative AI Lenses.
updates.action: For clients with existing Snap DPA campaigns, re-baseline performance after the DPA engine swap. Snap Smart Assistant is worth testing on new-account setup where objective-selection is often the first mistake.

updates.title: WPP Media Signs AWS Strategic Deal on Agentic AI
updates.summary: WPP Enterprise Solutions signed a strategic collaboration agreement with AWS on June 18 to operationalise agentic AI for brands, part of the Elevate28 transformation and follow-on from the January GroupM to WPP Media rebrand.
updates.action: Expect competitive noise from WPP Media pitches through H2 2026 emphasising AWS-backed agentic workflows - RFP responses for independent agencies should position speed and human craft against WPP's agent story.

updates.title: Meta Expands Live Video Ads to Instagram Globally at Cannes
updates.summary: On June 17, Meta expanded Live Video Ads globally on Facebook and brought them to Instagram for the first time. Partners CommentSold, Firework, LiveMeUp, Sprii, and TalkShopLive can turn eligible livestreams into promotable ads. Meta also announced a virtual card checkout (Mastercard/Visa) and expanded creator affiliate programs.
updates.action: For ecommerce clients running live shopping, connect through one of the five partner platforms this quarter to unlock paid reach beyond followers. Meta claims 9-30% conversion vs. 2-3% for standard ecommerce - worth testing budget reallocation from static catalog ads.

updates.title: Pinterest Launches Business Assistant, MCP Server, and Performance+ AI Creative
updates.summary: On June 17, 2026 ahead of Cannes Lions, Pinterest unveiled Business Assistant (closed-beta AI collaborator in Ads Manager), a Pinterest MCP server for agentic tools, and Performance+ dynamic creative selection that picks variants per ad impression.
updates.action: Add Pinterest MCP to the same agent stack being tested for TikTok and Meta. For Pinterest-active clients, request Business Assistant closed-beta access before Q4 planning.

updates.title: OpenAI Publishes Ad Tools Terms For Audience And Creative Tools
updates.summary: On or around June 17, 2026, OpenAI published Ad Tools Terms defining two optional advertiser features: Audience Tools (upload first-party customer data / suppression lists / segments for custom audiences) and Creative Tools (AI generation, modification, localisation, translation of ad creative from a brand's own assets). Both are policy-announced and pending, not yet live in Ads Manager as of publication.
updates.action: Read the Ad Tools Terms and get client legal to review the data-reuse clause before uploading any first-party data when the tools go live. Warehouse suppression lists and CRM segments now so the moment Audience Tools ships you can move fast.

updates.title: Microsoft Advertising Expands LinkedIn Job Seniority Targeting Across Search and Audience
updates.summary: On June 16, 2026 Microsoft Advertising expanded LinkedIn Profile targeting to include 10 standardized job seniority levels (CXO, VP, Director, Manager, Senior, Entry, Owner, Partner, Training, Volunteer) across Search and Audience campaigns, at both campaign and ad group level. Available in Americas, EMEA and APAC markets.
updates.action: For B2B accounts on Microsoft Ads, layer LinkedIn seniority filters at the ad group level in observation mode first for 14 days, then apply targeting (or bid modifiers) on the seniority segments that show measurable CVR lift. Best fit for enterprise sales-cycle campaigns.

updates.title: Comscore Native Segments Land in Amazon DSP
updates.summary: In June Comscore announced Proximic contextual and ID-free Predictive Audience segments are natively available in Amazon DSP. Segments include contextual, brand suitability, and ID-free Predictive Audience options activated across CTV, web, and mobile inventory in Amazon DSP's third-party web supply.
updates.action: For Amazon DSP campaigns on privacy-first cohorts, layer Comscore Proximic segments as an alternative to identity-based targeting. Especially useful for cookieless test cells.

updates.title: Smart Bidding Exploration And Promotion Mode Beta Roll Out Globally
updates.summary: On June 15, 2026, Google made Smart Bidding Exploration globally available in Performance Max campaigns without product feeds and opened a beta for Shopping. It also launched Promotion Mode beta, allowing temporary ROAS-tolerance and extra-budget shifts for peak events.
updates.action: Turn on Smart Bidding Exploration on feedless PMax campaigns, and plan Promotion Mode windows around client sale dates rather than blunt budget doublings.

updates.title: Microsoft Ads Launches Product Explorer For Merchant Center Catalog Insights
updates.summary: On June 12, 2026, Microsoft launched Product Explorer inside Merchant Center for US advertisers with fewer than 100K SKUs. It offers a searchable catalog view across 15 attributes plus performance data and a Recommended Actions tab for products that stopped serving.
updates.action: Have paid-shopping teams filter Product Explorer for stopped-serving items on eligible clients and clear metadata gaps as the first pass of any shopping optimization sprint.

updates.title: Google Expands Limited Ad Serving Policy To Google Search
updates.summary: On June 12, 2026, Google extended its limited ad serving policy to Google Search with phased enforcement through 2028. Advertisers can be judged 'unqualified' via persistent negative user feedback or unclear advertiser identity, and see impression volume capped on specific queries.
updates.action: Audit every client's ad copy and LP for clear brand identity, and monitor Google Ads notifications for limited-serving flags now that the policy applies to Search.

updates.title: OpenAI Launches Product Feed Ads In ChatGPT Ads Manager Beta
updates.summary: OpenAI activated product feed ads in ChatGPT Ads Manager on June 11-12, 2026 (feed management moved to a dedicated Feeds section June 2). Advertisers can upload catalogues up to 2 million items (1M SKUs per advertiser, 100-product sample required for opening full catalogue). OpenAI reported a global DTC pilot doubled CTR and cut CPC 50% vs standard ChatGPT ads.
updates.action: For any ecomm/DTC client on ChatGPT Ads, migrate to feed-based ads immediately - the CTR/CPC deltas are too big to ignore. Prep clean Merchant Center feeds (titles, images, attributes) that map cleanly to ChatGPT feed spec.

updates.title: LinkedIn Launches Creator Marketplace and BrandWorks Inside Campaign Manager
updates.summary: On June 10-11, 2026 LinkedIn launched its Creator Marketplace (alpha, US and Canada, English content only) inside Campaign Manager, letting B2B brands search vetted creators by topic, review audience composition, find existing organic and sponsored posts mentioning their brand, and amplify via Thought Leader Ads. BrandWorks, LinkedIn's in-house brand studio, was announced alongside.
updates.action: If a client has a US/Canada B2B ICP and any influencer or thought-leader budget, request Creator Marketplace invite access now. Use it as the discovery layer before running Thought Leader Ads instead of paying an external creator agency retainer.

updates.title: Walmart Connect and Google Activate Audiences in DV360 YouTube
updates.summary: On June 11, Walmart Connect and Google announced Walmart's first-party audiences can be activated inside DV360 with YouTube as the first inventory type. Advertisers can target Walmart omnichannel segments and measure confirmed Walmart purchases without leaving DV360.
updates.action: For CPG/retail clients selling through Walmart, add DV360 YouTube plans built on Walmart Connect audiences; measure incrementality against direct Walmart Connect on-site placements.

updates.title: Amazon Ads Launches Agentic Shopping Playbook and Alexa+ Ads
updates.summary: On June 11 Amazon Ads published its agentic shopping playbook framed around Alexa for Shopping, which unifies Rufus and Alexa+ into a single AI shopping layer. Amazon announced Alexa+ Agentic Ads at Cannes - a new format where users see an ad and complete a purchase without leaving the ad.
updates.action: For Amazon sellers, prioritize catalog hygiene (attributes, images, A+ content) so product data resolves cleanly inside Alexa answers. Plan creative for the new Agentic Ads format from Q3.

updates.title: GroupM Midyear Forecast Puts Global Ad Market at $1.27T
updates.summary: WPP Media's This Year Next Year midyear 2026 forecast projected global advertising at $1.27 trillion with digital over 73% of the total. US ad revenue growth expected 11.9% driven by AI investment; social remains the largest single channel.
updates.action: Use the $1.27T total plus 73% digital share as the baseline for FY27 client media plan narratives; anchor budget-increase conversations to the AI-fuelled US growth number.

updates.title: Meta Retires Off-Platform Activity Opt-Out, Consolidates Under New Setting
updates.summary: On June 9, Meta announced it is discontinuing the 'Your activity off Meta technologies' opt-out setting. Pixel and Conversions API data will now personalize Feed content and Meta AI responses in addition to ads, all governed by a single 'Activity from other businesses' setting. Rollout starts July 2026 across US, UK, Brazil and more.
updates.action: Expect stronger signal and better delivery efficiency on ecommerce clients as more off-platform activity feeds Meta's models. Update client privacy notices to reflect the new consolidated control and be ready to defend the policy shift to privacy-conscious brands.

updates.title: New York AI Performer Disclosure Law Takes Effect June 9
updates.summary: New York's synthetic performer disclosure law took effect June 9, 2026, becoming the first US state law requiring conspicuous disclosure when an ad uses an AI-generated human performer. Applies to any advertising served to New York consumers.
updates.action: Add mandatory disclosure to all client creative reviews when AI-generated humans appear on-camera or in voice, especially for national campaigns that hit NY audiences.

updates.title: Meta Rolls Out Post-View Skippable Reels Ads Placement Globally
updates.summary: On June 8, Meta began phased rollout of a new Reels placement: a skippable video ad that plays after someone finishes an eligible organic Reel longer than 60 seconds. A countdown appears on the organic clip; the ad is bookable through existing Reels ad tools and rolls to all advertisers worldwide over a phased window.
updates.action: Test the placement in every eligible sales and awareness campaign this month before it becomes default inventory. Repurpose existing 9:16 Reels creative - the placement is a warm-up top-of-funnel slot, so lead with a strong first 2 seconds. Report on skip-rate vs. video view-through.

updates.title: Performance Max Gets Structured Asset A/B Testing
updates.summary: On June 8, 2026, Google rolled out asset experiments for Performance Max, letting advertisers head-to-head test asset groups, individual assets, or seasonal vs evergreen creative using a 40-bucket split, 95% confidence threshold and 4-6 week minimum run.
updates.action: Queue a PMax asset experiment on each ecom client to isolate one hero image or headline this quarter and document lift instead of guessing at creative fatigue.

updates.title: Perplexity Raises $200M For Comet Browser As 'Agent Economy Front Door'
updates.summary: In June 2026, Perplexity raised $200M specifically to fund its Comet agentic browser (iOS launched March 2026, hit #3 on iOS App Store). Perplexity has abandoned in-answer ads as of Feb 2026 - the monetisation thesis has pivoted to ad-targeting from browsing data plus Pro/Max subscriptions. In pending Amazon litigation, Perplexity argued Comet 'bypasses the advertising layer including sponsored product placements' when it completes purchases.
updates.action: Watch the Amazon vs Perplexity ruling closely - if agentic browsers can legally bypass ad layers on retailer sites, Meta/Google Shopping economics change materially. Advise ecomm clients that PDP/checkout content must be machine-readable, not ad-dependent, for agentic traffic.

updates.title: ChatGPT Ads Launch In The UK, OpenAI's First European Market
updates.summary: OpenAI opened its ChatGPT Ads Manager beta to UK advertisers on June 6, 2026, making the UK the first European market after the US, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. Sponsored placements appear below organic ChatGPT responses for logged-in Free and Go tier users only (not Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise/Edu). Targeting uses 'context hints' - descriptions of conversations - not keywords.
updates.action: Register UK clients at openai.com/advertisers and stand up context-hint libraries for each account. Because Plus/Pro users don't see ads, position ChatGPT Ads as a lower-income/broader-consumer channel in media plans, not premium B2B.

updates.title: TikTok Streaming Ads Beat Standard Campaigns in 80% of Year-Long Tests
updates.summary: PPC Land reported (June 2026) that TikTok's Streaming Ads - a catalog-driven format for streaming services launched Jan 2026 - beat standard campaigns in 80% of tested cases across the year-long pilot, pairing service catalogs with Smart+ automation to match viewers to specific shows/films.
updates.action: Not relevant for most clients yet - Streaming Ads are gated to streaming-service catalogs. Note the format-plus-Smart+ pattern; the same catalog-driven approach is likely to expand to other verticals in 2027.

updates.title: MRC Awards YouTube First Short-Form Video Brand Safety Accreditation
updates.summary: On June 5 the Media Rating Council awarded YouTube its brand safety accreditation for the sixth consecutive year and expanded it to include Shorts. YouTube is the first platform to earn MRC brand safety accreditation for short-form video.
updates.action: Update brand safety guardrail language in client media plans to note Shorts is now MRC-accredited, unlocking Shorts inclusion in strict brand-safety RFPs previously restricted to long-form.

updates.title: Amazon Marketing Cloud Extends Lookback to 24 Months Plus Prime Video Insights
updates.summary: AMC 2026 updates rolled out no-SQL workflows, enhanced Ads Agent with right-click AI controls, 24-month lookback (up from 13), Custom Models, APIs, and Paid Features. Prime Video streaming insights are now available so brands can measure how video exposure influences shopping.
updates.action: For AMC clients, rebuild CLV models on the 24-month window to expose lifetime purchase patterns previously invisible. Add Prime Video streaming exposure to your attribution model.

updates.title: Meta Launches Business Agent Globally Across WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram
updates.summary: At Conversations 2026 on June 3, Meta made its AI-powered Business Agent available to businesses of all sizes worldwide. The agent answers customer questions, recommends products from the catalog, books appointments, qualifies leads, closes sales, and hands off to humans. Over 1 million businesses were already using it before the global launch.
updates.action: For any client running click-to-message or WhatsApp Business ads, spin up a Business Agent this quarter while it is free. Paid subscription tiers are coming later in the year and Meta Business Agent Platform (token-billed) rolled to enterprise August 1, so the free window is closing fast.

updates.title: Google Updates Terms Of Service Ahead Of July 2026 AI Rollout
updates.summary: On June 2, 2026, Google announced Terms of Service updates that take effect July 1, 2026 clarifying how advertiser inputs can be used across AI and automated tools, and reinforcing advertisers' responsibility to review AI-generated assets, targets and destinations.
updates.action: Brief clients on the new ToS scope and add an internal QA step for any auto-generated headlines, targets or destinations before campaigns go live.

updates.title: MRC Reaffirms Nielsen Big Data Plus Panels Currency Accreditation
updates.summary: The Media Rating Council reaffirmed accreditation for Nielsen's Big Data + Panels national TV currency, keeping Nielsen certified as buyers weigh alternative currency options for CTV and linear campaigns.
updates.action: Client currency conversations for 2027 upfront commitments can now include reaffirmed Nielsen as the accredited baseline while comparing VideoAmp, iSpot, and Comscore alternatives.

updates.title: Microsoft Clarity AI Citation Tracking Goes Generally Available
updates.summary: In May 2026, Microsoft Clarity announced its AI Visibility beta went generally available - the first free tool for tracking how often pages are cited by AI. Data comes from Microsoft Copilot and partner AI platforms, surfacing three metrics: total citation count, Share of Authority (SoA), and AI referral traffic. In June, Clarity added content recommendations to turn citation insights into GEO next steps.
updates.action: Install Microsoft Clarity on every client site that doesn't already have it - it's free and the AI citation data now rivals paid tools like Profound/Athena for basic tracking. Bake SoA into monthly client reports as the AEO-equivalent of impression share.

updates.title: Seer Study: AI Overviews Cut Clicks 58%, But Cited Sites Gain 35% More Organic Clicks
updates.summary: A May 2026 Seer Interactive study across 53 brands, 5.47M queries and 2.43B impressions found the presence of an AI Overview correlates with a 58% lower CTR for the top-ranking page. Pew Research's 68K-query controlled study confirmed a 46.7% relative decline. But brands cited inside AI Overviews saw 35% more organic clicks and 91% more paid clicks than un-cited position-one sites. Semrush data shows the first organic result CTR drops from 41.3% to 18.6% when an AIO fires.
updates.action: Reset organic forecasts for every client using the 46-58% haircut on AIO-triggering keywords. Prioritise GEO/AEO work to become the cited source - the paid-click uplift (91%) is a real budget-defence argument.

updates.title: Omnicom Doubles IPG Merger Cost Savings Target to $1.5B
updates.summary: Post the November 2025 IPG merger completion, Omnicom's Q1 2026 revenue hit $6.24B and the company doubled its cost savings target to $1.5B, with $1B tied to labor reductions. Approximately 4,000 positions to be eliminated worldwide; FCB, MullenLowe, and DDB agency networks being retired.
updates.action: Watch client rosters for account moves as Omnicom collapses agency networks; opportunity to pitch mid-market clients displaced from consolidated teams.

updates.title: DoubleVerify Extends Post-Bid Measurement to LinkedIn Audience Network
updates.summary: LinkedIn expanded its DoubleVerify partnership on May 21, 2026 to include global post-bid measurement for LinkedIn Audience Network campaigns. Advertisers get third-party verification of viewability, invalid traffic (IVT), brand suitability and intended geography on off-platform inventory.
updates.action: For clients running Audience Network extensions, enable DV post-bid tags in Campaign Manager and pull a weekly viewability/IVT report. Use it to justify keeping or cutting LAN spend versus keeping delivery confined to the LinkedIn feed.

updates.title: Google I/O 2026: AI Mode Passes 1 Billion Monthly Users, Gemini 3.5 Flash Default
updates.summary: At Google I/O on May 19-21, 2026, Google confirmed AI Mode has crossed 1 billion monthly users with query volume more than doubling every quarter. AI Overviews sits at ~2.5 billion MAU. Google also stated ~92-94% of AI Mode sessions end without a click to an external website.
updates.action: Reset client expectations on organic CTR - zero-click resolution is the new default. Push GEO/AEO work (entity depth, natural language, citations) alongside SEO. Prioritise ads inside AI Mode not around it.

updates.title: Reddit Ships Max Campaigns For App Ads, App Event Optimization, And Dual Attribution Beta
updates.summary: Reddit announced Max Campaigns for App Ads in beta (15% lower CPA, 28% more results in early tests), App Event Optimization for specific in-app conversions (22% CPA improvement), and a Dual Attribution beta that gives advertisers first-party visibility into Reddit's influence on conversion decisions beyond standard MMM-style models.
updates.action: For app-install clients already running Reddit, request Max Campaigns beta access this week and stand up App Event Optimization on at least one downstream in-app event (subscribe, purchase, level-up). Add Reddit Dual Attribution alongside MMP data so attribution conversations stop crediting only last-click sources. Re-baseline CPA targets after 4 weeks.

updates.title: Business Agent For Leads Replaces Static Lead Forms With Gemini Chat
updates.summary: Announced at GML on May 20, 2026, Business Agent for Leads inserts a Gemini-powered chat trained on the advertiser's website into Search ads, pre-filling forms only after the conversation qualifies the user. Runs in open US beta and requires AI Max or Performance Max.
updates.action: Shortlist US lead-gen clients in education, auto and real estate for the beta and warn them lead volume may drop as chat-quality gating filters low-intent prospects.

updates.title: Asset Studio Upgraded With Gemini Omni Video And 1-Click Creative Testing
updates.summary: Google upgraded Asset Studio on May 20, 2026 with Gemini-powered text, image and video generation via natural-language prompts, Gemini Omni multimodal video workflows, and 1-Click Creative Testing to identify winning assets. Rolls out globally in English through summer.
updates.action: Load client brand guidelines into Asset Studio and test 1-Click Creative Testing on PMax asset groups instead of only running external creative refresh cycles.

updates.title: Google Tests Conversational Ad Formats In AI Mode And Search
updates.summary: At Google Marketing Live on May 20, 2026, Google unveiled new Gemini-built ad formats for AI Mode and Search, including Conversational Discovery ads that generate tailored creative around a searcher's specific question.
updates.action: Audit clients' AI Overview/AI Mode visibility now and prep feed and asset quality so the new conversational units have accurate product context to draw on.

updates.title: Google Launches Ask Advisor Gemini Agent Across Ads, Analytics, Merchant Center
updates.summary: Announced at Google Marketing Live on May 20, 2026, Ask Advisor is a unified Gemini-powered agent that spans Google Ads, Analytics, Merchant Center and Google Marketing Platform. It is in beta for English-language accounts and can move across products in a single prompt.
updates.action: Enroll English-market client accounts in the beta and pilot Ask Advisor for cross-product reporting queries before adopting it for optimization actions.

updates.title: Google Folds Meridian MMM Into GA360 With Qualified Future Conversions Metric
updates.summary: Google's open-source MMM, Meridian, will integrate natively into Google Analytics 360 in summer 2026, plus a new Qualified Future Conversions metric predicting conversions up to 6 months out. MMM moves from specialist workstream to standard GA360 reporting, covering TikTok, Pinterest, Snap, and Google channels in one view.
updates.action: For clients on Analytics 360, schedule a Meridian onboarding call with Google reps to lock implementation in summer. Pull data exports of current spend by channel back 24 months so the MMM has a training window ready. Add Qualified Future Conversions to weekly reporting templates and reset client KPI expectations to mix near-term and predictive signals.

updates.title: GML 2026: Ask Advisor Unifies Google's AI Agents, DSA Auto-Migrates To AI Max In September
updates.summary: Google consolidated Ads Advisor, Analytics Advisor, and Merchant Center Advisor into one Ask Advisor agent (English beta global) with shared memory across the stack. Dynamic Search Ads will auto-migrate to AI Max in September 2026, removing manual keyword selection and routing query matching through Gemini, with knock-on landing-page logic to audit now.
updates.action: Run a DSA audit across every account this month: list all active DSA campaigns, the target pages, and current query coverage. Identify accounts where DSA routing to generic landing pages would tank performance under AI Max (e.g., granular ecom catalogs). Plan a Q3 restructure into Performance Max or AI Max-ready Search before September auto-migration.

updates.title: Google Marketing Live 2026: Conversational Discovery Ads And Highlighted Answers Land In AI Mode
updates.summary: Google Marketing Live 2026 introduced two new Gemini-powered Search ad formats inside AI Mode: Conversational Discovery Ads (multi-turn dialogue that surfaces products in-stream) and Highlighted Answers (sponsored answer cards on Q&A queries). The shift treats AI Mode as a paid surface, with new measurement signals and conversational click semantics.
updates.action: Brief clients now that AI Mode is becoming a paid surface, not a free Q&A traffic source. Audit current top informational queries and identify which would map to Conversational Discovery (consideration journeys) versus Highlighted Answers (single-question intent). Ask your rep for beta access. Do not over-promise CPAs until measurement semantics for multi-turn click attribution settle.

updates.title: Microsoft Advertising Activate 2026 Unveils AI Max Open Pilot And Performance Max Transparency
updates.summary: At Activate on May 19, 2026, Microsoft announced AI Max for Search opening to an open pilot around end-May/early-June, plus custom-column conversion metrics, enhanced PMax search-term insights, Copilot root-cause analysis and Ad Preview Hub.
updates.action: Nominate high-spend Bing search accounts for the AI Max open pilot and rebuild reporting templates to use the new PMax search-term visibility for optimization stories.

updates.title: Meta Deprecates Advantage+ Shopping And App Campaign APIs From May 19
updates.summary: Meta deprecated Advantage+ Shopping (ASC) and Advantage+ App (AAC) campaign creation, duplication, and updates across all Marketing API versions from May 19. Existing campaigns keep running, but new builds must use the unified Advantage+ Sales objective. Agencies on legacy automation tools need to refactor before the endpoints retire fully.
updates.action: Audit any internal tooling, scripts, or third-party platforms that still call ASC or AAC endpoints and migrate to the Advantage+ Sales objective this sprint. Document which clients have legacy ASC campaigns still live so you can plan a managed rebuild rather than getting forced into a rebuild mid-quarter. Tell the team: existing live campaigns still spend, but anything new is blocked.

updates.title: Meta Threads Ads Hit Full Global Rollout With Carousels And Video Formats
updates.summary: Meta completed the Threads ads global rollout, adding static carousels and video ads as standard placements. All eligible Meta advertisers can now toggle Threads into existing campaigns alongside Facebook and Instagram, and the platform supports 4:5 ratios as well as 1:1 and 9:16 vertical creative natively for brand and DR campaigns.
updates.action: Enable Threads as a placement on 1-2 best-performing Advantage+ campaigns this week and monitor for 14 days before scaling. Repurpose vertical Reels creative for the carousel and video slots, do not commission new assets yet. Watch for placement-level reporting noise: Threads CPMs often run lower than Instagram but conversion quality is still proving out.

updates.title: Meta Extends Purchase Audience Retention Window to 730 Days
updates.summary: Starting May 18, 2026, advertisers can set audience retention to a maximum of 730 days (up from 180) when selecting purchase events in website and app custom audiences. Existing 180-day purchase audiences auto-updated to 730 days unless advertisers opted out beforehand.
updates.action: Audit every purchase-based retargeting and exclusion audience across all Meta accounts this week. Prospecting audiences that exclude past purchasers now exclude two years of buyers, which will materially shrink reach and likely raise CPMs. Rebuild any 180-day windows manually where the two-year setting hurts scale.

updates.title: TikTok Launches Ads MCP Server for Third-Party AI Agents
updates.summary: TikTok released its Ads Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at TikTok World on May 12, 2026, letting third-party AI agents plan, launch, and optimize TikTok campaigns directly - joining Google and Meta's MCP servers as the standard integration layer for agentic media buying.
updates.action: Media buyers should test agent-run TikTok workflows (bid adjustments, budget reallocation, targeting) via Claude/ChatGPT + MCP for reporting and low-risk changes before delegating spend authority.

updates.title: TikTok World '26 Unveils TopReach, Symphony Automation, and Search Hubs
updates.summary: At TikTok World on May 12-14, 2026, TikTok launched TopReach (unified TopView + TopFeed buy guaranteeing one impression per user), Smart+ Symphony Automation (gen-AI creative baked into automated campaigns), and Search Hubs (brand-owned search destinations at the top of TikTok search results).
updates.action: Add TopReach to consideration set for launch and awareness campaigns needing single-day 100% reach. For Smart+ users, enable Symphony Automation so the platform auto-generates and enhances creative variants inside live campaigns.

updates.title: TikTok Introduces Mini Series Format and Growth Max Amplification
updates.summary: At TikTok World '26, TikTok launched Mini Series - an in-app episodic drama format brands can build and publish natively - plus Growth Max, an automated ad solution that amplifies Mini Series discovery, engagement, and conversion across the funnel.
updates.action: For entertainment, gaming, and content-heavy CPG clients, storyboard a 3-6 episode Mini Series test in Q3. Growth Max makes distribution mechanical; the creative concept is the constraint.

updates.title: TikTok Symphony Creative Studio Goes Free Globally on Dreamina Seedance 2.0
updates.summary: As of May 2026, TikTok made Symphony Creative Studio - powered by ByteDance's Dreamina Seedance 2.0 video model - free to all TikTok advertisers globally with no separate subscription. New Voiceover Avatars support 30+ languages plus Product Avatars for on-screen items.
updates.action: Test Seedance 2.0 for low-budget creative variants and localized voiceover on international campaigns before commissioning production. Keep hero-cut spots on human production for now.

updates.title: YouTube Brandcast 2026: Buy With Google Pay Hits CTV, Multimodal Video Creation Ships
updates.summary: At Brandcast 2026, YouTube launched Buy With Google Pay on connected TV ads (two-tap living-room checkout), Custom Sponsorships that use AI to match brands to cultural moments, Affiliate Partnerships Boost on tagged creator videos, and Multimodal Video Creation powered by Gemini, Nano Banana, and Veo. CTV conversions grew 200% YoY in Q1 2026.
updates.action: For DTC and retail clients on YouTube CTV, request Buy With Google Pay access from your Google rep this week and stand up the Merchant Center plus Google Pay merchant accounts needed to enable it. Move one campaign to Affiliate Partnerships Boost against existing tagged creator videos. Pilot one Veo plus Nano Banana brief in Asset Studio before scaling production budget.

updates.title: Google Ads API v24.1 Adds AI Max Experiments, Mobile Device Segments, Passkey Auth
updates.summary: Google Ads API v24.1 shipped with four new experiment types (ADOPT_AI_MAX, ADOPT_BROAD_MATCH_KEYWORDS, OPTIMIZE_ASSETS, PMAX_REPLACEMENT_SHOPPING) so teams can A/B test those natively, plus iOS-vs-Android mobile segmentation, classic images in Demand Gen, and passkey auth. A 37-month data retention window takes effect June 1, 2026.
updates.action: Ask your dev or reporting team to upgrade to v24.1 this sprint. Spin up an ADOPT_AI_MAX or PMAX_REPLACEMENT_SHOPPING experiment on one mid-sized account to get internal data before the bigger AI Max migration in September. Backfill any historical performance pulls beyond 37 months before June 1 to avoid losing granularity.

updates.title: TikTok World 2026 Opens Third-Party AI Agents, Symphony Upgrades, And Search Hubs
updates.summary: TikTok World 2026 launched third-party AI ad agents for autonomous campaigns, Symphony upgrades on Seedance 2.0 (Voiceover Avatars in 30+ languages, Product Avatars), TopReach with creative sequencing, and brand-owned Search Hubs atop TikTok Search results. The platform is collapsing creative, campaigns, and discovery into one AI stack.
updates.action: If TikTok spend is over $20K per month, request a Search Hub on the brand handle and a TopReach test slot this quarter. Pilot 2-3 Symphony Voiceover Avatar variants in secondary languages against current best UGC. Hold off on third-party AI agents until conversion tracking and dual attribution are validated on a small budget.

updates.title: Magnite Crosses 50% CTV Revenue Share In Q1 2026
updates.summary: Magnite reported its first Q1 profit with Connected TV crossing 51% of contribution ex-TAC for the first time. The milestone confirms CTV has overtaken display and mobile web as the dominant programmatic format on a top-3 SSP, reshaping where ad budgets and creative investment need to flow in 2026.
updates.action: For any DTC or lead-gen client spending more than $50K/month on social video, model a 10-15% reallocation test into programmatic CTV via DV360 or The Trade Desk next quarter. Repurpose existing 15s and 30s vertical creatives into 16:9 cuts now so the asset library is ready before Q3 upfront commitments lock supply.

updates.title: Google Surfaces Tag Manager Controls Inside Google Ads UI
updates.summary: Google Ads is testing in-platform Tag Manager controls so advertisers can deploy and edit tags without leaving the Ads UI. The move reduces friction for PPC managers bouncing between GTM, GA4, and Google Ads, and signals tighter consolidation of the measurement stack inside Ads itself.
updates.action: When the toggle appears in your account, do not rip out your existing GTM container. Instead, audit which Google Ads conversion and remarketing tags actually need to live in GTM versus directly in Ads. Document tag ownership between PPC and analytics teams before May ends to avoid duplicate firing and inflated conversion counts.

updates.title: Google Drops FAQ Rich Results From Search SERPs
updates.summary: Google confirmed FAQ rich results stopped appearing May 7. Search Console reporting and Rich Results Test support are removed in June 2026, API support gone by August. The change closes a long-standing SERP real-estate play and forces brands to rethink how they capture above-the-fold space for question queries.
updates.action: Audit pages relying on FAQ schema for CTR uplift this week and reallocate that content into PAA-friendly H2/H3 question blocks, AI Overview-eligible answer paragraphs, and product-detail snippets. Keep FAQPage markup live for other engines but stop investing in expansion. Pull pre/post May 7 impressions to size revenue exposure.

updates.title: LinkedIn and Amazon Ads Bring B2B Targeting to CTV
updates.summary: LinkedIn partnered with Amazon Ads on May 7, 2026 to bring LinkedIn first-party audience signals (job title, industry, seniority) to streaming TV inventory via Amazon DSP through Microsoft Monetize. B2B decision-makers can now be reached on premium CTV inventory using LinkedIn targeting.
updates.action: For upper-funnel B2B brand campaigns with a CTV budget line, request access to LinkedIn audiences through Amazon DSP. Best-fit use case is target-account ABM where LinkedIn seniority and title data extends to lean-back streaming environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Ads Expands Custom Columns To All Conversion Metrics
updates.summary: Microsoft Advertising expanded Custom Columns to support the full conversion-data set, including both all-conversions and primary-conversion variants. Advertisers can now build cost per qualified lead, blended CPA, and goal-level ROAS columns natively. Confirmed by Microsoft product liaison Navah Hopkins.
updates.action: Rebuild your Microsoft Ads reporting view this week with 3 custom columns: cost-per-primary-conversion, blended-CPA (all conversions), and ROAS-by-goal. Match the column logic to your Google Ads view so cross-platform comparisons are apples-to-apples. Update any Looker Studio or Sheets exports pulling Bing data to include the new metrics.

updates.title: Google Ads Adds Journey-Aware Bidding and Demand-Led Pacing
updates.summary: Google rolled out Journey-Aware Bidding (tCPA learns from non-biddable goals), Smart Bidding Exploration for PMax and Shopping (27% avg lift in unique converters), and Demand-Led Budget Pacing that auto-shifts spend to higher-demand days. Advertisers on total budgets reported 66% fewer manual budget edits.
updates.action: For B2B and long-cycle lead-gen accounts, opt into Journey-Aware Bidding beta and feed it 2-3 non-biddable upstream actions (MQL, demo-booked, SQL). Switch eligible PMax and Shopping campaigns to monthly total budgets to unlock Demand-Led Pacing. Re-baseline tCPA targets after 4 weeks before judging performance.

updates.title: Off-Platform Event Ads Reach Full Global Rollout
updates.summary: LinkedIn's Off-Platform Event Ads reached global GA on May 6, 2026, letting advertisers run Event Ads that click through to external webinar sites, livestreams or registration forms rather than a LinkedIn Event Page. Format supports awareness, engagement, website visits and lead-gen objectives.
updates.action: For B2B webinar and event campaigns, test Off-Platform Event Ads when the CRM, form fields or consent flow must stay on your own stack. Keep a LinkedIn-native Event Ad running in parallel and compare CPL after 14 days before shifting spend.

updates.title: LinkedIn Launches Agency Certification Program For B2B Shops
updates.summary: LinkedIn introduced an org-level Ads Agency Certification requiring a Business Manager, monthly invoicing setup, and a staff quota completing LinkedIn Marketing Academy modules. Certified agencies get an official badge, external messaging rights, and LinkedIn-led promotion. The credential is tied to the agency, not individuals.
updates.action: If you run more than $20K/month of LinkedIn spend across clients, kick off certification this week. Stand up Business Manager, request invoicing if you bill on cards, and assign 3-5 senior buyers to complete Marketing Academy tracks (strategy, targeting, optimization, measurement). Use the badge in pitch decks for B2B RFPs.

updates.title: ChatGPT Ads Launches Self-Serve Manager With CPC Bidding
updates.summary: OpenAI opened a self-serve ads manager for ChatGPT with CPC bidding, campaign tools, and improved measurement, lowering the entry bar for SMBs. Early data shows strong CTRs on high-intent queries like Mother's Day shopping, though scaled inventory and audience size remain the open questions for paid teams.
updates.action: Spin up a small test budget ($500-1,500/week) in the new ChatGPT self-serve UI on a high-intent shopping or comparison query set. Mirror your best Google Search RSA copy, set conversion tracking via UTM + server-side, and benchmark CTR and CPA against Google Search after 14 days before scaling.

updates.title: AI Search Shift: Brand Authority Now Beats Topical Authority
updates.summary: Search Engine Land published May 4 that AI systems prioritise brand mentions and visibility over the breadth of topical coverage that won classic SEO. Authority signals shape which sources get cited in AI answers. Companion pieces released the same day cover 7 tools for AEO and citation tracking.
updates.action: Reweight content roadmaps: fewer topic-cluster pillar posts, more high-quality citations and brand mentions on authoritative sources. Add an AEO tool to every SEO-active client (track which queries cite the brand in ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews) and report citation share quarterly.

updates.title: Ad Blockers Are Selling User Browsing Data - 80+ Chrome Extensions, 6.5M Users
updates.summary: PPC Land reported May 4 that 80+ Chrome ad-blocker extensions, with 6.5 million combined users, legally sell user browsing data to third parties. The disclosure is buried in privacy policies. Marketers gain a counter-narrative on ad-blocker virtue while raising fresh concerns about data marketplaces.
updates.action: Use this in any client conversation framing ad-blocker users as privacy-pure. The data shows otherwise. For brands worried about brand safety on data brokers: audit which DSPs and DMPs source from ad-blocker telemetry and exclude where possible.

updates.title: Bauer Study: 96% of Advertisers Back Audio But Spend Gap Persists
updates.summary: A Bauer Media study released May 3 found 96% of advertisers cite confidence in audio (podcasts, digital radio, streaming) yet audio still captures a fraction of total ad budget. Gap reflects measurement limitations and inertia rather than channel performance.
updates.action: If a client has zero audio in the mix, run a small podcast-host-read test (£2-5K) against the strongest Meta cold-traffic audience. Use a unique URL or vanity code so attribution is clean. Audio is the most under-priced reach channel right now per advertiser sentiment.

updates.title: Week of May 4 Marketing Brief: Meta Overtakes Google, IAB $294.6B, AI Mode 93% Zero Click
updates.summary: Five trends crystallised the week of May 4: Meta projected to overtake Google in 2026 worldwide ad revenue ($243.46B vs $239.54B). IAB pegs 2025 US digital ad spend at $294.6B with social up 32.6% and search only 11%. AI Mode hits 1B+ queries/month, 93% zero-click. Creator economy on track for $44B.
updates.action: Three immediate moves: (a) Reweight 2026 media plans toward Meta - growth differential is now 24.1% vs Google 11.9% so the channel CAC math has shifted. (b) Treat AI Mode citations like SEO - audit which client URLs Google is citing in AI answers and feed that into the content roadmap. (c) Convert the largest creator project into a 12-month always-on contract instead of campaign-by-campaign briefs.

updates.title: TikTok Adds Manual Keyword Management for Uploads
updates.summary: TikTok rolled out manual keyword management on top of automatic tagging on May 1. Creators can review auto-assigned keywords during upload, remove irrelevant terms, and add their own. TikTok Studio surfaces popular search terms before posting. Mirrors YouTube's tag system.
updates.action: Brief social teams to manually tag every brand upload (organic and paid creator content) with 5-10 high-intent search terms drawn from TikTok Studio inspiration. This is free reach for TikTok-as-search behaviour. Audit recent posts and add keywords retroactively where the platform allows it.

updates.title: Reddit Q1 2026 Ad Revenue Up 74% YoY, Gaining Social Share
updates.summary: Reddit reported Q1 2026 advertising revenue of $625M (up 74% YoY), with agency checks showing continued Q2 social ad-share gains driven by contextual targeting, high-intent audience, and incremental reach. Q2 guidance is $715-725M revenue.
updates.action: For B2C and considered-purchase clients not on Reddit yet, run a Q3 test budget. Reddit's Max campaigns and Shopify DPA integration have lowered setup friction meaningfully.

updates.title: X Rebuilds Entire Ad Platform From Scratch - 20-Year First
updates.summary: X confirmed a ground-up rebuild of its Ads Manager, the most significant overhaul in the company's 20-year history. New platform runs on xAI retrieval and ranking systems and shipped in phased rollout from April. Three pillars: simplicity, control, AI-powered performance.
updates.action: Reopen the X test for any client where the audience skews male, tech, finance or political. The xAI ranking layer is genuinely new. Run a 4-week 5K test against a Meta-comparable audience and compare CAC before scaling spend or ruling it out.

updates.title: Pinterest Launches "Anti-Social Media" Brand Campaign Across TV, Cinema, OOH
updates.summary: Pinterest's first major brand campaign of 2026 launched May 1 across TV, cinema, OOH and digital, telling viewers to put down social media and live their lives. The pitch positions Pinterest as the antidote to AI-flooded Meta and TikTok feeds.
updates.action: Pinterest is making a credible bid to be the brand-safe, intention-rich alternative to Meta and TikTok. Worth reopening the channel for any client where the buyer plans purchases (home, wedding, beauty, parenting, B2C SaaS with visual product). Run a 4-week brand-lift test with shoppable Pins before the H2 budget round.

updates.title: OpenAI Builds EU Compliance Infrastructure for ChatGPT Ads Launch
updates.summary: Code updates to OpenAI's conversion pixel reveal EU-specific infrastructure: upfront consent management, advertiser action exclusions, and a country jurisdiction field. Pixel ships managed-service only (no self-serve yet). The live US pilot is also expanding to Canada, Australia and New Zealand.
updates.action: If you run brands across EU and US, plan for ChatGPT ads as a real channel within 3-6 months. Start tagging conversion events with consent-state metadata so the same tracking model works for both regions. Watch the managed-pilot waitlist - early access is the moat here while supply is throttled.

updates.title: Google Ads API v20 Sunsets June 10 - All Requests Will Fail
updates.summary: Google reminded advertisers that API v20 sunsets June 10 2026. After that date all v20 requests fail, breaking automated reporting, bidding scripts, and campaign management workflows still on the old version. Migration to a newer version is mandatory before the deadline.
updates.action: Audit every script, bidding tool, and reporting integration for the API version it calls. Anything still on v20 must migrate before June 10. Highest risk: agency reporting dashboards, custom bidding scripts, and any Looker Studio/BigQuery pipeline using the legacy version.

updates.title: Google Ads Cuts Granular Data Retention to 37 Months Starting June 1
updates.summary: Google announced May 1 that the Google Ads API, scripts, and Analytics Data API will only return granular daily/hourly/weekly data for the last 37 months from June 1. Reach and frequency drop to 36 months. Monthly and yearly aggregates remain at 11 years. DV360 and CM360 are unaffected.
updates.action: Before June 1: export any year-over-year analyses or long-window training data you rely on (especially for budget pacing models and seasonality benchmarks). Pull a clean BigQuery snapshot of pre-2023 daily data NOW, store it in cold storage, and stop relying on the live API for anything older than 3 years. Update internal scripts that query 36+ month windows to fail gracefully.

updates.title: Reddit Q1 2026: Ad Revenue Up 74% to $625M, DAUs Hit 126.8M
updates.summary: Reddit reported Q1 2026 ad revenue of $625 million, up 74 percent year-over-year. Global daily active users grew 17 percent to 126.8 million (53.5 million in the US). Performance is now 60 percent of total ad revenue, driven by the Reddit Max AI optimisation suite and Dynamic Product Ads.
updates.action: Reddit has graduated from experimental channel to performance contender. Add it to the test plan for any client with intent-driven communities (DTC, B2B SaaS, niche services). Start with Reddit Max + DPA when catalogue is ready.

updates.title: X Begins Phased Rollout of AI-Rebuilt Ad Platform
updates.summary: X announced (April 30, 2026) and continued in June 2026 a phased rollout of a rebuilt ad platform with modern retrieval and ranking systems. AI-powered Optimized Targeting delivered +10% CTR and +16% conversion rate in beta; 92% of testers kept it on. Ad Manager improvements are landing week by week through June 16, 2026.
updates.action: For clients still running X campaigns, opt into Optimized Targeting on all conversion objectives. Do not migrate spend from Meta/TikTok on the strength of beta numbers alone - track incremental conv and CPA weekly.

updates.title: HubSpot April 2026 Developer Rollup: Legacy CRM Card Migration Tool, Client Secret Rotation, Custom Channels API
updates.summary: HubSpot's April 2026 developer changelog landed: a Legacy CRM Card View Swapping Tool to migrate deprecated cards to UI Extension App Cards (deadline Oct 31, 2026), client secret rotation directly inside the developer platform UI (no support ticket needed), and Custom Channels API gains explicit contact association and sender attribution on outgoing messages.
updates.action: If a client uses Legacy CRM Cards, schedule the migration before October. If you manage HubSpot apps, rotate client secrets via the new UI immediately. For Custom Channels integrations, update outgoing message handlers to leverage the new attribution fields.

updates.title: Alphabet Q1 2026: Google Network Ad Revenue Falls 4% While Search and YouTube Climb
updates.summary: Alphabet reported Q1 2026 revenue of 109.9 billion dollars, up 22 percent. Google Search hit 60.4 billion (up 19 percent) and YouTube ads 9.88 billion (up 11 percent), but Google Network advertising fell 4 percent to 6.97 billion as AI Overviews and agentic surfaces resolve queries inside Google rather than sending traffic to publishers.
updates.action: Reconsider any heavy reliance on Display Network and AdSense placements for performance buys. Brief teams that the Search slowdown narrative is wrong (Search up 19 percent), but the long open-web monetisation story is genuinely cracking. Add YouTube to the must-test list if it is missing.

updates.title: Google Ads API to Expand Product Reporting on June 15 to Cover Video, Demand Gen, App, and Full PMax Network
updates.summary: Google announced the Ads API will add cost and conversion metrics to product-level reporting for Video, Demand Gen, and App campaigns from June 15, plus complete network coverage for Performance Max. Backfill is not retroactive: requests for dates before the launch will not contain the expanded data.
updates.action: If you run product-level dashboards (Looker Studio, BigQuery), schedule a refresh of API queries for June 15. Capture a clean cutover snapshot so post-June data can be benchmarked. Tell agency reporting teams ahead of time so they don't misread the historical gap.

updates.title: Meta Q1 2026: $55B Ad Revenue Up 33%, 8M Advertisers Now Use AI Creative Tools
updates.summary: Meta reported $55.02 billion in advertising revenue for Q1 2026, up 33 percent year-over-year. Ad impressions rose 19 percent and average price per ad increased 12 percent. AI creative tool adoption doubled to over 8 million advertisers (from 4 million at end of 2024); video generation features showed a 3 percent gain in conversion rate at scale.
updates.action: Meta's AI creative tools are now mainstream, not experimental. Make Advantage Plus video generation a default test on every new campaign for clients that aren't already using it. Use the 33 percent rev growth as evidence for clients hesitating to up Meta spend.

updates.title: LinkedIn Launches Off-Platform Event Ads for External Webinars and Livestreams
updates.summary: LinkedIn rolled out Off-Platform Event Ads, letting marketers run Event Ads that link directly to third-party webinar platforms, landing pages, or livestream sites without a native LinkedIn Event page. Global rollout completes by May 6 and supports awareness, engagement, traffic, and lead gen objectives. Performance stays trackable in Campaign Manager.
updates.action: B2B teams running webinars on Zoom, ON24, or Goldcast should switch to Off-Platform Event Ads instead of generic Single Image Ads. Use the event-specific CTA and accelerated delivery to spike registrations in the final 7 days before the event.

updates.title: Snapchat Launches AI Sponsored Snaps - Brand AI Agents in the Chat Tab
updates.summary: Snapchat rolled out AI Sponsored Snaps on Apr 28: brand AI agents placed directly inside the app's main Chat tab where users can ask questions and get product recommendations. Builds on existing Sponsored Snaps which deliver 22 percent more conversions at 20 percent lower CPA per Snapchat. Q1 2026 saw 950 billion chats sent on Snapchat.
updates.action: Brands with strong product Q&A surface area (beauty, electronics, fashion fit) should pilot an AI Sponsored Snaps agent. Treat as an evergreen channel between campaign flights, not a campaign add-on.

updates.title: Meta One-Click Conversions API Goes Live to All Advertisers
updates.summary: Meta's free, one-click CAPI setup went live globally on Apr 27, accessible inside Events Manager with no developer required. The Meta-enabled CAPI runs server-side with auto-deduplication and applies to web events.
updates.action: If you skipped the Apr 15 announcement, do not skip the live release - turn on one-click CAPI for every Meta client this week. No reason left to run Pixel-only.

updates.title: IAS Launches Total TV - Show, Genre, Rating Visibility for CTV Advertising
updates.summary: Integral Ad Science launched IAS Total TV on Apr 27, bringing show, program, genre, rating, and language-level transparency to CTV advertising plus device, viewability, and IVT verification. Available across Disney, NBCUniversal, Paramount, Prime Video, and opted-in Publica publishers.
updates.action: If a client buys CTV, layer IAS Total TV verification on their next flight. Compare the show-level breakdown against the agency's blended dashboard - it almost always reveals waste.

updates.title: Magnite Launches Buyer Agent Plus SpringServe AI Mediation - Disney, Kepler, MiQ Test First
updates.summary: Magnite unveiled an AI-powered buyer agent (in test with Kepler and MiQ on Disney Advertising inventory) and added agentic AI mediation features inside SpringServe (anomaly detection, demand path optimisation, dynamic pricing). Publicis Media Exchange and Spectrum Reach are also collaborating.
updates.action: If a client uses Disney CTV or Magnite supply, ask the agency about access to the buyer agent. For SSP-side teams, Magnite mediation tests are worth piloting on premium video inventory.

updates.title: OpenAI ChatGPT Ads Pilot Crosses $100M Annualised Revenue in Six Weeks
updates.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT advertising pilot crossed $100 million annualised in six weeks of launch, driven largely by FOMO from brands like Williams-Sonoma and DSW rather than proven returns yet. Industry observers caution that focusing on generative engine optimisation may currently outperform paid ChatGPT inventory.
updates.action: If a client wants to test ChatGPT ads, frame it as a learning agenda not a performance allocation. Run small CPC budgets in parallel with a serious GEO push (clean structured data, brand citations, content fit for LLM answers).

updates.title: TikTok Expands Brand Safety and Measurement Coverage to Search, Smart+ and TikTok Lite
updates.summary: TikTok widened its measurement partnerships with IAS, Zefr, and DoubleVerify, with coverage now reaching Search ads, Smart+, GMV Max, and TikTok Lite formats. DoubleVerify also became the first vendor MRC-accredited for TikTok video viewability.
updates.action: If you have paused TikTok testing on brand safety grounds, revisit Search and Smart+ now that third-party measurement is live. Add IAS or DoubleVerify tags to all new TikTok campaigns going forward and benchmark IVT against your Meta and YouTube buys.

updates.title: Meta AI Business Assistant Goes Generally Available to All Advertisers and Agencies
updates.summary: Meta moved its AI Business Assistant out of beta to all advertisers and agencies across major global markets. Early users reported a 20 percent higher rate of resolving account issues and a 12 percent decrease in cost per result after applying its recommendations.
updates.action: Open Ads Manager and start using the AI Business Assistant on disabled accounts, payment errors, and underperforming campaigns. Track CPR before and after applying its recommendations to validate the 12 percent claim on your own data before scaling adoption.

updates.title: PayPal Launches Curated Ads, Bringing Transaction-Linked Attribution to CTV
updates.summary: PayPal unveiled Curated Ads, a CTV measurement and audience platform that uses PayPal transaction data to build segments and tie streaming ad exposure to actual sales. Launch partners include Warner Bros. Discovery, Tubi, and Spectrum Reach.
updates.action: Direct response brands testing CTV should request access via WBD or Tubi inventory. Compare PayPal-attributed conversions against your existing MMM or Innovid measurement before reallocating budget. Treat as one more data partner, not a single source of truth.

updates.title: Q1 2026 Ad Spend Report: YouTube Up 20 Percent, Facebook Only 4 Percent
updates.summary: Tinuiti's Q1 2026 report covering over 4 billion dollars in annual digital ad spend shows double-digit growth across YouTube, Google Search, and Amazon Sponsored Products, with Facebook a notable laggard at only 4 percent growth. Instagram pulled ahead inside Meta, with Reels driving nearly a third of impressions and 28 percent year-over-year investment.
updates.action: If your Meta budget is still 70 percent Facebook, rebalance toward Reels and Instagram given the impression and growth gap. Recheck YouTube share of your video budget. Treat Amazon Sponsored Products as a search competitor, not a side bet.

updates.title: Demand Gen Adds Commerce Media Suite Support and View-Through Conversion Optimisation
updates.summary: Google added Demand Gen support inside Commerce Media Suite plus view-through conversion optimisation specifically for YouTube traffic in Demand Gen campaigns. This connects creative + audience signals across YouTube, Discover, and Gmail with retail-grade optimisation.
updates.action: Brief any retail or DTC client on the new VTC optimisation for YouTube Demand Gen. Test against your current Demand Gen build using a side-by-side experiment.

updates.title: Home Depot's Orange Apron Media Adds Self-Serve Reddit Buying Inside Orange Access
updates.summary: Home Depot's retail media network Orange Apron Media announced at its third annual InFronts an industry-first self-service integration that lets advertisers launch Reddit campaigns directly inside Orange Access using The Home Depot's first-party audience data. Display geotargeting is live now, with expansions through 2026.
updates.action: Brands selling on Home Depot or in adjacent home-improvement categories should test the OAM-Reddit self-serve path for first-party-data-fuelled Reddit reach. Compare ROAS against direct Reddit Ads with similar audience inputs.

updates.title: Meta Adds Reply Moderation to Threads Ads
updates.summary: Meta rolled out a reply moderation tool for Threads ads, letting advertisers view, hide, and respond to top-level replies on their ad creatives. Requires specific permissions in Business Manager.
updates.action: Assign reply moderation permissions to a community manager for any Threads campaign that risks spam or off-brand replies, especially for B2B and regulated industries.

updates.title: Meta Tests Carousel Ads, Advantage+ Catalog Ads and Advantage+ App Ads on Threads
updates.summary: Meta is testing three new ad formats on Threads: Carousel Ads, Advantage+ Catalog Ads, and Advantage+ App Ads. Threads now has 400+ million MAUs and supports Threads-only ad targeting plus Instagram-and-Facebook account-based ad publishing without a Threads profile.
updates.action: Brands without a Threads profile but a Meta presence: test running Threads ads in your next campaign as a discovery placement. Catalog and App formats hit feature parity with IG/FB.

updates.title: WPP Integrates Google Earth AI Into WPP Open for Geospatial Media Planning
updates.summary: WPP plugged Google Earth AI into its WPP Open marketing platform, combining satellite imagery with AI reasoning for geospatial intelligence. Use cases shown include weather and traffic-aware insurance campaigns and media buying optimisation for EV markets.
updates.action: If a client is location-sensitive (insurance, retail with footfall, EV, real estate), ask their agency whether they have access to WPP Open Earth AI or a comparable Esri or Foursquare layer. For DIY teams, replicate the principle by overlaying weather and footfall data manually on your geo bid adjustments.

updates.title: Netflix Pitches Dynamic Ad Insertion for 2027 Women's World Cup
updates.summary: Netflix is offering advertisers dynamic ad insertion for its 2027 Women's World Cup broadcast. Buyers are cautiously interested but flag concerns over high CPMs and technical scalability for live streaming.
updates.action: If you are a sports or DTC advertiser, ask Netflix for early access pricing now and request audience composition data before committing. Compare CPMs against YouTube live and Amazon Prime sports inventory before locking spend.

updates.title: OpenAI Launches CPC Ads in ChatGPT, Shifting From Pure Impression Pricing
updates.summary: OpenAI started testing cost-per-click ads in ChatGPT, with early reports placing clicks in the 3 to 5 dollar range. The shift gives advertisers a performance-based pricing option alongside the existing CPM-based units and lands ChatGPT closer to direct competition with Google Search ads.
updates.action: If you tested ChatGPT ads on a CPM basis and gave up, retest on CPC where you only pay for clicks. Benchmark CPCs against Google Search brand and non-brand. Build a one-page test plan now so you can move quickly when access opens to your account.

updates.title: Google Ads API v24 Adds CartDataSalesView, 9 New Lead Gen Conversion Types, Retail Filters
updates.summary: Google released Google Ads API v24 with the new CartDataSalesView resource (track what products customers actually buy, not just clicked), nine new lead gen conversion type enums across GA4 and Firebase, tag-based retail filter targeting for Shopping campaigns, view-through conversion optimisation for Demand Gen and App, and gender exclusions for Performance Max.
updates.action: Brief your dev or agency PPC team to map the new lead gen conversion enums to existing CRM and form events. For ecommerce, test gender exclusions on PMax where they are commercially appropriate. Add CartDataSalesView to your weekly product-level reporting once the upgrade is live.

updates.title: Google Changes Budget Pacing Rules for Campaigns With Ad Schedules
updates.summary: Starting June 1, Google Ads will pace budgets to spend the full monthly amount (30.4 times daily budget) regardless of how many days a campaign is eligible to run. Advertisers using limited ad schedules will see accelerated spending on active days unless they re-tune.
updates.action: Audit every campaign with an ad schedule before June 1. Reduce daily budgets in proportion to the number of active days, or expect overspend. Watch dayparting tests closely after the change goes live.

updates.title: Microsoft Launches AI Max for Search, Offer Highlights, Copilot Checkout, Universal Commerce Protocol
updates.summary: On Apr 21 Microsoft unveiled an agentic-web ad stack: AI Max for Search (open pilot in May, expanded query matching, asset personalisation, smarter URL routing), Offer Highlights (selling points surfaced inside AI conversations on Copilot/Bing chat), Copilot Checkout for in-Copilot purchases, AI Visibility tracking inside Microsoft Clarity, an AI-powered Audience generation tool, and Universal Commerce Protocol support.
updates.action: Audit Microsoft Ads accounts for AI Max readiness: tighten asset feeds, verify Final URL templates, and opt into the May open pilot. Add AI Visibility tracking to standard Clarity dashboards for Microsoft Ads clients. Brief Offer Highlights tests (free shipping, returns, financing) into your roadmap.

updates.title: Webby Winners Show Brand Creative Now Pulls From Internet Culture, Not Onto It
updates.summary: Webby Media Group's executive director Jesse Feister highlighted a shift in the 2026 winners: brands are drawing creative inspiration from internet and creator culture and using physical real-world activations to spark online conversation, rather than pushing brand content onto the web.
updates.action: Audit your creative briefs for net-new branded ideas vs creator and culture remixes, and skew toward the latter for testing. Plan at least one real-world activation per quarter that is designed to be filmed and reshared on TikTok and Reels.

updates.title: Google Rolls Out Three Agentic AI Safety Features in Ads Advisor
updates.summary: Google added Real-Time Policy Reviews (in-workflow flagging during campaign edits), 24/7 security monitoring with personalised dashboards, and instant certifications to Ads Advisor. The features are English-only at launch with more languages coming.
updates.action: Look for the new safety surface inside Ads Advisor and adopt early on accounts that have had policy or trust issues. Use Real-Time Policy Reviews to catch violations before submission instead of after disapproval.

updates.title: 87 Percent of Agency Pros Say the Traditional Agency Model Is Broken
updates.summary: A Basis survey of 213 advertising professionals found 87.3 percent believe the traditional agency model is broken today or will be within 3-5 years. Among senior leaders the figure rises to 91.5 percent. Drivers: AI adoption, martech stack complexity, and client in-housing.
updates.action: If you are pricing agency retainers, stress test the model against AI automation of reporting, pulls, and creative. The edge going forward is strategy, execution velocity, and proprietary data not headcount hours.

updates.title: Google Clarifies Election Ads Are Exempt From YouTube and Discover Placement Requirements
updates.summary: Google updated documentation to confirm that election ads are exempt from the standard YouTube and Discover Feed ad requirements while still bound by broader Google Ads policies. This is a clarification, not a new rule.
updates.action: If you run election or political campaigns in a region Google supports, make sure Election Ads verification is current. Other advertisers: no action needed, but useful to know for regulated-industry client questions.

updates.title: Google Ads Asset Studio Speeds Up Creative but Shifts Work to PPC Managers
updates.summary: Google Ads Asset Studio now generates images and videos inside the platform with AI, removing the budget barrier to short-form video. But reviewers report limited creative control and more production responsibility landing on paid search managers instead of creative teams.
updates.action: Use Asset Studio for fast message and voiceover tests before committing to full production. Plan for the governance gap: Asset Studio does not flag AI content, so build your own disclosure process before New York's synthetic performer law hits in June 2026.

updates.title: Google Tests Video Ads Inside Local Pack Search Results
updates.summary: Google is testing video ads that appear directly in local pack results, wired through Google Ads Location Manager. For high intent location queries like near me, restaurants, or services, video adds an immersive layer map results have never had before.
updates.action: If you run Local campaigns or Performance Max for store goals, start producing short vertical video now so you can opt in when the test expands. Best hooks: 3-second store exterior, live staff shot, signature product close up.

updates.title: CNIL Publishes Final Rules on Email Tracking Pixels with 3-Month Transition
updates.summary: France's CNIL adopted binding guidance on email tracking pixels. Open-rate tracking, campaign optimization pixels, and audience profiling now require explicit opt-in consent. Only basic deliverability tracking like last-open date is permitted without consent.
updates.action: If you email French or EU recipients, audit your ESP setup now. Add one-click unsubscribe or consent-withdrawal links in every email footer. Three-month transition means cleanup by mid-June 2026.

updates.title: AI-Referred Traffic Now Converts 42 Percent Better Than Non-AI for US Retailers
updates.summary: New Adobe data shows AI referral traffic to US retail sites grew 393 percent year over year in Q1 2026. In March, AI driven visits converted 42 percent better than non AI traffic, a full reversal from a year ago when AI traffic was 38 percent less likely to convert.
updates.action: Audit your PLP and PDP content for machine readability. Structured data, clear product attributes, and concise FAQs are what AI agents cite. Track ai.com, chatgpt.com, and perplexity.ai referrals in GA4 as a first party signal of AI channel lift.

updates.title: OpenAI Starts Rolling Out Ads to Free and Go Users in Australia, New Zealand, Canada
updates.summary: OpenAI expanded its ad monetization to free and lower-tier Go users in Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. Premium tiers stay ad free. The format inside conversational AI is still being defined, and agencies are in early test mode.
updates.action: If you sell in ANZ or Canada, get on the early access list so you learn placement mechanics before competitors. Keep budgets small, and focus on high intent audiences. Measurement is still thin, so treat spend as learning investment.

updates.title: Google Ads Tests Direct Google Tag Manager Integration for Conversion Setup
updates.summary: Google is testing a conversion setup flow that pushes conversion tracking directly into Google Tag Manager, removing the manual copy and paste of IDs. Fewer handoffs should mean fewer implementation errors for new conversion actions.
updates.action: Watch for a Set up in Google Tag Manager option inside your conversion setup flow. Once it appears, use it for new conversions. Also audit existing conversions for manual setup errors you can clean up when the integration goes broad.

updates.title: Google Ads API to Require Multi-Factor Authentication from April 21
updates.summary: Google is mandating MFA for Google Ads API users starting April 21, 2026. New OAuth 2.0 refresh token generation needs a second verification factor. Existing tokens keep working, and service account workflows are exempt.
updates.action: Enable 2-step verification on all developer accounts now. For automated or offline agency tooling, consider moving to service account workflows. Also affects Google Ads Editor, Scripts, BigQuery Data Transfer, and Data Studio.

updates.title: Amazon Ads Launches Cross-Account Reach and Frequency Reporting Across Sponsored Ads + DSP
updates.summary: Amazon Ads launched cross-account de-duplicated reach and frequency reporting on Apr 2, combining Sponsored Ads and Amazon DSP investments into a single unified view. Available across 36 markets in NA, SA, EMEA, and APAC via the Reporting (beta) UI and the public reporting API. Frequency-group measurement now extends to manager-account and cross-manager-account level.
updates.action: Ecommerce clients running both Sponsored Ads and DSP should pull the cross-account R&F report monthly to identify wasted overlap. Replace your old siloed Sponsored vs DSP reach decks with this single unified view in client reporting.

updates.title: Microsoft April 2026 PMax Update: Google Ads Import, Final URL Reporting, 400-Char Names, RSA AI Assets
updates.summary: Microsoft's April 2026 product roundup ships PMax import from Google Ads (incl. NCA goals + automatic audience conversion), Final URL landing-page reporting for PMax, seasonality adjustments for portfolio bid strategies, campaign name limit raised to 400 chars (parity with Meta and Google), AI-generated text assets for underoptimised RSAs, and direct Merchant Center store name and domain edits.
updates.action: Migrate eligible Google PMax campaigns into Microsoft using the new import path. Turn on Final URL reporting on existing PMax to find leaky LPs. Audit any RSAs with under 8 user-supplied headlines for AI auto-asset opportunities.

updates.title: Meta Launches Muse Spark Shopping Experience That Pulls from Creators and Brand Content
updates.summary: Meta introduced a new AI shopping experience built on its Muse Spark model. It recommends outfits, home styling, and gift ideas by pulling from creator content and brand storytelling already on Instagram and Facebook. Live on the Meta AI app now and rolling out on IG and FB.
updates.action: If you sell on IG or FB, make sure your brand storytelling and creator partnerships are rich and well tagged. Muse Spark cites owned and earned content you already have, so thin or off-brand posts will be missed. Check Partnership Ads hub for creator content to amplify.

updates.title: Meta Announces AI-Enhanced Pixel and One-Click Conversions API Setup
updates.summary: Meta announced AI-enhanced Meta Pixel automation (auto-adds product and business info into pixel signals) plus a one-click no-code Conversions API setup. The CAPI feature is server-side, includes built-in deduplication, and ships with the 17.8 percent lower cost-per-result claim Meta made earlier.
updates.action: For every client still on Pixel-only, schedule a one-click CAPI setup this week. Re-run a CPR baseline 2 weeks after to validate the 17.8 percent claim.

updates.title: LinkedIn Expands AI Conversational Search Sitewide
updates.summary: LinkedIn rolled out AI powered conversational search to all users, after a Premium only preview. The new search understands natural language, nickname variations, and spelling tolerance, and shows AI summaries explaining why each member appears.
updates.action: Update your own and clients' LinkedIn profiles and company pages with specific keywords, job titles, and industry terms that match how buyers describe the problem. Verification badges and complete profiles surface higher, so close those gaps.

updates.title: March 2026 Google Core Update Hits 79 Percent of Top-3 Results, Favors Primary Sources
updates.summary: Search Engine Land data on the March 2026 core update shows 79.5 percent of top-3 URLs changed position, up from 66.8 percent in December. Winners were official sites, specialist platforms, government domains, and employer pages. Losers were aggregators, directories, and broad discovery platforms including YouTube.
updates.action: Audit SEO clients against the aggregator vs primary source split. Consolidate owned data, push expertise signals, and reduce reliance on third party aggregation pages. Brands with Knowledge Panels and authored content gained the most.

updates.title: Google Shoppable CTV Goes Fully Live in Demand Gen
updates.summary: Google's Shoppable CTV format moved from limited rollout to fully live in Demand Gen campaigns, letting viewers click product elements during streaming inventory.
updates.action: Ecom clients running Demand Gen should test Shoppable CTV with their top SKUs. Measure incremental revenue against standard YouTube buy on the same audience.

updates.title: Google Universal Commerce Protocol Adds Cart, Catalog, and Identity Linking
updates.summary: Google updated its Universal Commerce Protocol with a Cart option to save and add multiple items, a Catalog capability for real-time product detail surfacing, and Identity Linking that preserves loyalty benefits across surfaces and platforms.
